+++ game/scripts/snake_controller.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name SnakeController
+
+signal ate_orb
+signal died
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var segments: Array = [] # Array of Vector2 grid positions, head at index 0
+var segment_nodes: Array = []
+var direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT
+var move_timer: Timer
+var speed_level: int = 1
+var move_interval: float = 0.18
+var pending_grow: int = 0
+
+func _init():
+    pass
+
+func setup(gm: Node) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+    # create timer
+    move_timer = Timer.new()
+    move_timer.one_shot = false
+    move_timer.wait_time = move_interval
+    add_child(move_timer)
+    move_timer.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "_on_move_timer"))
+    move_timer.start()
+    # initial snake: 3 segments in center
+    segments.clear()
+    segment_nodes.clear()
+    var start = Vector2(5,5)
+    segments.append(start)
+    segments.append(start - Vector2(1,0))
+    segments.append(start - Vector2(2,0))
+
+    # visual nodes: simple ColorRect style via Sprite2D created here
+    _rebuild_visuals()
+
+func _rebuild_visuals() -> void:
+    for n in segment_nodes:
+        if is_instance_valid(n):
+            n.queue_free()
+    segment_nodes.clear()
+    for i in range(segments.size()):
+        var s = Sprite2D.new()
+        s.texture = null
+        s.modulate = Color(0.3,1.0,0.3)
+        s.centered = true
+        s.scale = Vector2(0.9,0.9)
+        add_child(s)
+        segment_nodes.append(s)
+    _update_visuals()
+
+func _update_visuals() -> void:
+    for i in range(segments.size()):
+        var cell = segments[i]
+        var pos = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+        var node = segment_nodes[i]
+        node.position = pos
+        node.z_index = 10 - i
+
+func set_speed_level(level: int) -> void:
+    if level != speed_level:
+        speed_level = level
+        # adjust interval
+        move_interval = max(0.04, 0.18 - (speed_level - 1) * 0.02)
+        if move_timer:
+            move_timer.wait_time = move_interval
+
+func set_direction(dir: Vector2) -> void:
+    # avoid reversing
+    if dir + direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+        return
+    direction = dir
+
+func _on_move_timer() -> void:
+    # read input for direction (keyboard support here for simplicity)
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_up"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(0,-1))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_down"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(0,1))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(-1,0))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(1,0))
+
+    var new_head = segments[0] + direction
+    # collision with walls
+    if game_manager and game_manager.is_cell_blocked(new_head):
+        emit_signal("died", "wall")
+        game_manager.on_snake_death("wall")
+        return
+    # collision with self
+    for i in range(1, segments.size()):
+        if segments[i] == new_head:
+            emit_signal("died", "self")
+            game_manager.on_snake_death("self")
+            return
+    # move body
+    segments.insert(0, new_head)
+    if pending_grow > 0:
+        pending_grow -= 1
+    else:
+        segments.pop_back()
+    _update_visuals()
+
+    # check orb
+    if game_manager and game_manager.orb_manager and game_manager.orb_manager.consume_orb_at(new_head):
+        pending_grow += 1
+        emit_signal("ate_orb")
+        if game_manager:
+            game_manager.register_orb_eaten()
+
+func is_occupying_cell(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    for c in segments:
+        if c == cell:
+            return true
+    return false
+
+func grow(n: int=1) -> void:
+    pending_grow += n
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    # reset to initial
+    segments.clear()
+    segments.append(Vector2(5,5))
+    segments.append(Vector2(4,5))
+    segments.append(Vector2(3,5))
+    pending_grow = 0
+    direction = Vector2(1,0)
+    set_speed_level(1)
+    _rebuild_visuals()
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # slight wobble for body segments (visual only)
+    for i in range(1, segment_nodes.size()):
+        var node = segment_nodes[i]
+        var wobble = sin(OS.get_ticks_msec() / 200.0 + i) * 2.0
+        node.position.y += wobble

--- game/scripts/orb_manager.gd
+++ game/scripts/orb_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name OrbManager
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var orbs := {} # map "x,y" -> Dictionary {node, cell}
+
+func setup(gm: Node) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+
+func spawn_orb() -> void:
+    if not game_manager:
+        return
+    var cell: Vector2 = game_manager.get_random_free_cell()
+    var key = "%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
+    if orbs.has(key):
+        return
+    var s := Sprite2D.new()
+    var tex_path := "res://game/assets/orb.png"
+    if ResourceLoader.exists(tex_path):
+        s.texture = load(tex_path)
+    s.centered = true
+    s.position = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+    add_child(s)
+    orbs[key] = {"node": s, "cell": cell}
+
+func has_orb_at(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    return orbs.has("%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y])
+
+func consume_orb_at(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    var key = "%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
+    if not orbs.has(key):
+        return false
+    var data = orbs[key]
+    var node = data["node"]
+    if is_instance_valid(node):
+        node.queue_free()
+    orbs.erase(key)
+    # spawn particle effect if available
+    var pe_path := "res://game/resources/particle_effects.tscn"
+    if ResourceLoader.exists(pe_path):
+        var pe_res = load(pe_path)
+        if pe_res:
+            var inst = pe_res.instantiate()
+            add_child(inst)
+            inst.global_position = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+            var t = Timer.new()
+            t.one_shot = true
+            t.wait_time = 1.0
+            add_child(t)
+            t.connect("timeout", Callable(inst, "queue_free"))
+            t.start()
+    # spawn another orb after short delay
+    var t2 = Timer.new()
+    t2.one_shot = true
+    t2.wait_time = 0.5
+    add_child(t2)
+    t2.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "spawn_orb"))
+    t2.start()
+    return true
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    for key in orbs.keys():
+        var data = orbs[key]
+        var node = data["node"]
+        if is_instance_valid(node):
+            node.queue_free()
+    orbs.clear()

--- game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd
+++ game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name HazardBallController
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+
+func setup(gm: Node, initial_velocity: Vector2) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+    velocity = initial_velocity
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if velocity == Vector2.ZERO:
+        return
+    global_position += velocity * delta
+    # bounce against arena rect
+    if not game_manager:
+        return
+    var rect = game_manager.arena_rect_pixels
+    if global_position.x < rect.position.x + 4:
+        global_position.x = rect.position.x + 4
+        velocity.x = -velocity.x
+    elif global_position.x > rect.position.x + rect.size.x - 4:
+        global_position.x = rect.position.x + rect.size.x - 4
+        velocity.x = -velocity.x
+    if global_position.y < rect.position.y + 4:
+        global_position.y = rect.position.y + 4
+        velocity.y = -velocity.y
+    elif global_position.y > rect.position.y + rect.size.y - 4:
+        global_position.y = rect.position.y + rect.size.y - 4
+        velocity.y = -velocity.y
+
+    # check collision with snake head
+    if game_manager and game_manager.snake_controller:
+        var head_pos = game_manager.snake_controller.segments[0] * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+        if head_pos.distance_to(global_position) < TILE_SIZE * 0.6:
+            game_manager.on_snake_death("hazard")

changes.diff:
--- game/scripts/game_manager.gd
+++ game/scripts/game_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,240 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name GameManager
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+const ARENA_TILES := Vector2(20, 15) # width x height in tiles
+const ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE := ARENA_TILES * TILE_SIZE
+
+var arena_index: int = 1
+var arena_paths := [
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_1.tscn",
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_2.tscn",
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_3.tscn",
+]
+
+var arena_node: Node = null
+var wall_cells: Array = [] # Array of Vector2 grid cells
+var hazard_nodes: Array = []
+var orb_manager: Node = null
+var snake_controller: Node = null
+var ui_controller: Node = null
+var arena_rect_pixels: Rect2 = Rect2(Vector2(160,60), ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE)
+
+var score: int = 0
+var speed_level: int = 1
+var orbs_eaten: int = 0
+var game_over: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_setup_input()
+
+	# instantiate UI scene if present
+	var ui_path = "res://game/scenes/ui.tscn"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(ui_path):
+		var ui_res = load(ui_path)
+		if ui_res:
+			var ui = ui_res.instantiate()
+			add_child(ui)
+			if ui.has_method("setup"):
+				ui.setup(self)
+			ui_controller = ui
+
+	# orb manager (script-only class)
+	var orb_script_path = "res://game/scripts/orb_manager.gd"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(orb_script_path):
+		var orb_cls = load(orb_script_path)
+		if orb_cls:
+			orb_manager = orb_cls.new()
+			add_child(orb_manager)
+			if orb_manager.has_method("setup"):
+				orb_manager.setup(self)
+
+	# snake: prefer script class instance
+	var snake_script_path = "res://game/scripts/snake_controller.gd"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(snake_script_path):
+		var sc = load(snake_script_path)
+		if sc:
+			snake_controller = sc.new()
+			add_child(snake_controller)
+			if snake_controller.has_method("setup"):
+				snake_controller.setup(self)
+			if snake_controller.has_method("connect"):
+				snake_controller.connect("ate_orb", Callable(self, "_on_snake_ate_orb"))
+				snake_controller.connect("died", Callable(self, "_on_snake_died"))
+
+	_load_arena(arena_index)
+
+	# spawn a couple of starting orbs
+	if orb_manager:
+		for i in range(3):
+			orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+
+	if ui_controller:
+		ui_controller.update_score(score)
+		ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+
+	print("Neon Serpent")
+
+func _setup_input() -> void:
+	var actions = {
+		"move_up": [KEY_W, KEY_UP],
+		"move_down": [KEY_S, KEY_DOWN],
+		"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT],
+		"move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT],
+		"restart": [KEY_R],
+		"quit": [KEY_ESCAPE],
+	}
+	for name in actions.keys():
+		if not InputMap.has_action(name):
+			InputMap.add_action(name)
+		for code in actions[name]:
+			var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+			ev.physical_keycode = code
+			InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)
+
+func _load_arena(index: int) -> void:
+	if arena_node and is_instance_valid(arena_node):
+		arena_node.queue_free()
+	for h in hazard_nodes:
+		if is_instance_valid(h):
+			h.queue_free()
+	hazard_nodes.clear()
+	wall_cells.clear()
+
+	var path = arena_paths[(index - 1) % arena_paths.size()]
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
+		var res = load(path)
+		if res:
+			arena_node = res.instantiate()
+			add_child(arena_node)
+			for child in arena_node.get_children():
+				if typeof(child.name) == TYPE_STRING and child.name.begins_with("Wall"):
+					var cell = Vector2(int(child.position.x / TILE_SIZE), int(child.position.y / TILE_SIZE))
+					wall_cells.append(cell)
+				elif typeof(child.name) == TYPE_STRING and child.name.begins_with("HazardSpawn"):
+					# create hazard instance using script if available
+					var hb_script = "res://game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd"
+					if ResourceLoader.exists(hb_script):
+						var hb_cls = load(hb_script)
+						if hb_cls:
+							var hb = hb_cls.new()
+							add_child(hb)
+							var v = Vector2(randf() * 200 - 100, randf() * 200 - 100)
+							if hb.has_method("setup"):
+								hb.setup(self, v)
+							h.global_position = child.global_position
+							hazard_nodes.append(hb)
+						else:
+							var hb_path = "res://game/scenes/hazard_ball.tscn"
+							if ResourceLoader.exists(hb_path):
+								var hb_res = load(hb_path)
+								var hb2 = hb_res.instantiate()
+								add_child(hb2)
+								var v2 = Vector2(randf() * 200 - 100, randf() * 200 - 100)
+								if hb2.has_method("setup"):
+									hb2.setup(self, v2)
+								hb2.global_position = child.global_position
+								hazard_nodes.append(hb2)
+	arena_rect_pixels = Rect2(Vector2(160,60), ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE)
+
+func is_cell_blocked(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+	if cell.x < 0 or cell.y < 0 or cell.x >= ARENA_TILES.x or cell.y >= ARENA_TILES.y:
+		return true
+	for c in wall_cells:
+		if c == cell:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+func get_random_free_cell() -> Vector2:
+	var tries = 0
+	while tries < 200:
+		var x = randi() % int(ARENA_TILES.x)
+		var y = randi() % int(ARENA_TILES.y)
+		var cell = Vector2(x,y)
+		if is_cell_blocked(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("is_occupying_cell") and snake_controller.is_occupying_cell(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_orb_at(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		return cell
+	return Vector2(1,1)
+
+func register_orb_eaten() -> void:
+	score += 10
+	orbs_eaten += 1
+	if ui_controller:
+		ui_controller.update_score(score)
+	if orb_manager:
+		# spawn one immediately; orb_manager also schedules respawn when consumed
+		pass
+	if orbs_eaten % 5 == 0:
+		speed_level += 1
+		if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("set_speed_level"):
+			snake_controller.set_speed_level(speed_level)
+		if ui_controller:
+			ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+		_pulse_background()
+	if score >= 100:
+		print("WIN")
+		_advance_arena()
+
+func _pulse_background() -> void:
+	var t = create_tween()
+	t.tween_property(self, "modulate", Color(1.2,1.2,1.2,1), 0.15).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
+	t.tween_property(self, "modulate", Color(1,1,1,1), 0.25).set_delay(0.15)
+
+func _advance_arena() -> void:
+	arena_index = (arena_index % arena_paths.size()) + 1
+	score = 0
+	orbs_eaten = 0
+	speed_level = 1
+	if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("reset"):
+		snake_controller.reset()
+	if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_method("reset"):
+		orb_manager.reset()
+	_load_arena(arena_index)
+	if orb_manager:
+		for i in range(3):
+			orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+
+func on_snake_death(reason: String) -> void:
+	if game_over:
+		return
+	game_over = true
+	if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("pause_movement"):
+		snake_controller.pause_movement()
+	print("GAME OVER")
+	print("Final score: %d" % score)
+	if ui_controller and ui_controller.has_method("show_game_over"):
+		ui_controller.show_game_over(score)
+
+func _on_snake_ate_orb() -> void:
+	register_orb_eaten()
+
+func _on_snake_died(reason: String) -> void:
+	on_snake_death(reason)
+
+func _input(ev) -> void:
+	if game_over:
+		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+			game_over = false
+			score = 0
+			orbs_eaten = 0
+			speed_level = 1
+			if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("reset"):
+				snake_controller.reset()
+			if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_method("reset"):
+				orb_manager.reset()
+			_load_arena(arena_index)
+			if orb_manager:
+				for i in range(3):
+					orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+			if ui_controller:
+				ui_controller.update_score(score)
+				ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+		elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+			get_tree().quit()

notes.text:
Implementation contract (SHORT):

- Requirement -> owning files (core mappings)
  - 0 (title): game/scripts/game_manager.gd (sets OS.window_title) and game/project.godot (app name)
  - 1 (input): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (reads actions), game/scripts/game_manager.gd (adds InputMap bindings)
  - 2 (tweened movement): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (tween head and segments)
  - 4,5 (eat orb, +10 points): game/scripts/game_manager.gd (score), game/scripts/orb_manager.gd (spawn/consume), game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (emit moved signal)
  - 11-13 (death on hazard/wall/self): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (self/wall checks), game/scripts/game_manager.gd (is_blocked, handles game over)
  - 16-19 (UI, game over prompt, restart/quit): game/scenes/ui.tscn and game/scripts/ui_controller.gd; game_manager prints GAME OVER and final score and handles R/Esc.
  - Others (arenas, hazard, particles): files exist and are loadable; arena scenes implement wall nodes editable visually.

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - GameManager (game/scripts/game_manager.gd)
    - Owns: current arena instance, orb_manager, UI, game score, speed_level, arena index.
    - Methods:
      - func is_blocked(grid_pos:Vector2i) -> bool
      - func get_snake_positions() -> Array[Vector2i]
      - func on_snake_moved(new_head:Vector2i) -> void (connected)
      - func reset_game() -> void
  - SnakeController (game/scripts/snake_controller.gd)
    - Owns: snake grid positions: Array[Vector2i], move timer, growth flag, visual Sprites/Tweens.
    - Signals:
      - signal moved_to(new_pos: Vector2i)
      - signal died()
    - Methods:
      - func start(move_interval: float) -> void
      - func stop() -> void
      - func grow() -> void
      - func get_positions() -> Array[Vector2i]
  - OrbManager (game/scripts/orb_manager.gd)
    - Owns orb instances and spawning.
    - Methods:
      - func spawn_one() -> void
      - func consume_at(grid_pos:Vector2i) -> bool
  - UIController (game/scripts/ui_controller.gd)
    - Methods:
      - func update_score(score:int) -> void
      - func show_game_over(final_score:int) -> void
      - func hide_game_over() -> void

- Input -> action -> state -> feedback:
  - InputMap actions ("move_up/down/left/right", "restart", "quit") added by GameManager on _ready.
  - Snake's Timer triggers logical move: snake_controller reads Input.is_action_pressed each move to change direction (UP/W -> Vector2(-0,-1) etc.), validates against opposite direction, updates grid positions, tweens visuals.
  - After snake moves, emits moved_to(new_head). GameManager checks orb_manager.consume_at(new_head); if consumed, score +=10, ui.update_score, snake.grow(), check speed level increments and update snake timer via snake.start(new_interval). If snake detects wall or self collision, emits died(), GameManager handles game over: stops snake, prints "GAME OVER" + score, shows UI prompt.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Logical grid coordinates are Vector2i with tile size TILE_SIZE = 32. Visual world positions = grid * TILE_SIZE. Sprites are centered (Sprite2D.centered = true). Arena wall Position2D nodes are placed in editor in world coordinates (multiples of TILE_SIZE). Snake initial head at Vector2i(5,5).

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init: GameManager._ready loads arena_1, spawns snake & orb, sets UI, starts snake.
  - play: snake runs, GameManager reacts to signals.
  - win: when score >=100, GameManager prints "WIN" and loads next arena, resets snake.
  - lose: when snake dies, GameManager prints "GAME OVER <score>", shows UI prompt; waiting for R/Esc.
  - reset: pressing R calls GameManager.reset_game() which clears current snake/orbs, reloads current arena, resets score/speed, respawns snake and orbs.
  - quit: pressing Esc calls get_tree().quit().

Now I'll write the promised files (creating scenes and scripts) and then run a syntax check.

+var positions: Array = [] # Array of Vector2i
+var direction: Vector2i = Vector2i(1,0)
+var pending_direction: Vector2i = Vector2i(1,0)

+var _timer: Timer
+var _tween: Tween
+var _growing: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    _timer = Timer.new()
+    _timer.wait_time = move_interval
+    _timer.one_shot = false
+    add_child(_timer)
+    _timer.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "_on_move_tick"))
+
+    _tween = Tween.new()
+    add_child(_tween)
+
+    _init_snake()
+
+func _init_snake() -> void:
+    positions.clear()
+    for i in range(initial_length):
+        positions.append(initial_pos - Vector2i(i,0))
+    # Ensure visuals exist
+    if not has_node("Head"):
+        var head = Sprite2D.new()
+        head.name = "Head"
+        head.centered = true
+        add_child(head)
+    if not has_node("Body"):
+        var body = Node2D.new()
+        body.name = "Body"
+        add_child(body)
+    _rebuild_body_sprites()
+    _sync_visuals_immediately()
+
+func _rebuild_body_sprites() -> void:
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for child in body.get_children():
+        child.queue_free()
+    for i in range(max(0, positions.size()-1)):
+        var s = Sprite2D.new()
+        s.centered = true
+        body.add_child(s)
+
+func _sync_visuals_immediately() -> void:
+    var head = get_node("Head") as Sprite2D
+    head.global_position = positions[0] * TILE_SIZE
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for i in range(body.get_child_count()):
+        var s = body.get_child(i) as Sprite2D
+        var pos = positions[i+1]
+        s.global_position = pos * TILE_SIZE
+
+func start(p_move_interval: float) -> void:
+    move_interval = p_move_interval
+    if _timer:
+        _timer.wait_time = move_interval
+        _timer.start()
+
+func stop() -> void:
+    if _timer:
+        _timer.stop()
+
+func grow() -> void:
+    _growing = true
+
+func get_positions() -> Array:
+    return positions.duplicate()
+
+func _on_move_tick() -> void:
+    var input = Input
+    if input.is_action_pressed("move_up"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(0,-1)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_down"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(0,1)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(-1,0)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    # prevent reversing
+    if pending_direction + direction != Vector2i(0,0):
+        direction = pending_direction
+    var new_head = positions[0] + direction
+    positions.insert(0, new_head)
+    if not _growing:
+        positions.pop_back()
+    else:
+        _growing = false
+        _rebuild_body_sprites()
+    emit_signal("moved_to", positions[0])
+    _animate_to_positions()
+    # check self-collision
+    for i in range(1, positions.size()):
+        if positions[i] == positions[0]:
+            emit_signal("died")
+            stop()
+            return
+
+func _animate_to_positions() -> void:
+    _tween.kill()
+    var head = get_node("Head") as Sprite2D
+    _tween.tween_property(head, "global_position", positions[0]*TILE_SIZE, move_interval)
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for i in range(body.get_child_count()):

+        var target = positions[i+1] * TILE_SIZE
+        var wobble = Vector2.ZERO
+        var ang = (OS.get_ticks_msec() / 200.0) + i
+        wobble = Vector2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * 4
+        _tween.tween_property(s, "global_position", target + wobble, move_interval)
+    _tween.play()
+
+func reset_state() -> void:
+    stop()
+    _growing = false
+    direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    pending_direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    _init_snake()
+
+func _on_external_die() -> void:
+    emit_signal("died")
+    stop()

+    add_binding("restart", [KEY_R])
+    add_binding("quit", [KEY_ESCAPE])
+
+func _load_arena(index: int) -> void:
+    if current_arena:
+        current_arena.queue_free()
+        current_arena = null
+    if index < 0 or index >= arena_scenes.size():

+extends Node2D
+class_name SnakeController
+
+signal moved_to(new_pos: Vector2i)
+signal died()
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+
+@export var initial_length: int = 3
+@export var initial_pos: Vector2i = Vector2i(5,5)
+
+var positions: Array = [] # Array of Vector2i
+var direction: Vector2i = Vector2i(1,0)
+var pending_direction: Vector2i = Vector2i(1,0)
+var move_interval: float = 0.2
+var _timer: Timer
+var _tween: Tween
+var _growing: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    _timer = Timer.new()
+    _timer.wait_time = move_interval
+    _timer.one_shot = false
+    add_child(_timer)
+    _timer.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "_on_move_tick"))
+
+    _tween = Tween.new()
+    add_child(_tween)
+
+    _init_snake()
+
+func _init_snake() -> void:
+    positions.clear()
+    for i in range(initial_length):
+        positions.append(initial_pos - Vector2i(i,0))
+    # Ensure visuals exist
+    if not has_node("Head"):
+        var head = Sprite2D.new()
+        head.name = "Head"
+        head.centered = true
+        add_child(head)
+    if not has_node("Body"):
+        var body = Node2D.new()
+        body.name = "Body"
+        add_child(body)
+    _rebuild_body_sprites()
+    _sync_visuals_immediately()
+
+func _rebuild_body_sprites() -> void:
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for child in body.get_children():
+        child.queue_free()
+    for i in range(max(0, positions.size()-1)):
+        var s = Sprite2D.new()
+        s.centered = true
+        body.add_child(s)
+
+func _sync_visuals_immediately() -> void:
+    var head = get_node("Head") as Sprite2D
+    head.global_position = positions[0] * TILE_SIZE
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for i in range(body.get_child_count()):
+        var s = body.get_child(i) as Sprite2D
+        var pos = positions[i+1]
+        s.global_position = pos * TILE_SIZE
+
+func start(p_move_interval: float) -> void:
+    move_interval = p_move_interval
+    if _timer:
+        _timer.wait_time = move_interval
+        _timer.start()
+
+func stop() -> void:
+    if _timer:
+        _timer.stop()
+
+func grow() -> void:
+    _growing = true
+
+func get_positions() -> Array:
+    return positions.duplicate()
+
+func _on_move_tick() -> void:
+    var input = Input
+    if input.is_action_pressed("move_up"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(0,-1)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_down"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(0,1)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(-1,0)
+    elif input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
+        pending_direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    # prevent reversing
+    if pending_direction + direction != Vector2i(0,0):
+        direction = pending_direction
+    var new_head = positions[0] + direction
+    positions.insert(0, new_head)
+    if not _growing:
+        positions.pop_back()
+    else:
+        _growing = false
+        _rebuild_body_sprites()
+    emit_signal("moved_to", positions[0])
+    _animate_to_positions()
+    # check self-collision
+    for i in range(1, positions.size()):
+        if positions[i] == positions[0]:
+            emit_signal("died")
+            stop()
+            return
+
+func _animate_to_positions() -> void:
+    _tween.kill()
+    var head = get_node("Head") as Sprite2D
+    _tween.tween_property(head, "global_position", positions[0]*TILE_SIZE, move_interval)
+    var body = get_node("Body") as Node2D
+    for i in range(body.get_child_count()):
+        var s = body.get_child(i) as Sprite2D
+        var target = positions[i+1] * TILE_SIZE
+        var wobble = Vector2.ZERO
+        var ang = (OS.get_ticks_msec() / 200.0) + i
+        wobble = Vector2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * 4
+        _tween.tween_property(s, "global_position", target + wobble, move_interval)
+    _tween.play()
+
+func reset_state() -> void:
+    stop()
+    _growing = false
+    direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    pending_direction = Vector2i(1,0)
+    _init_snake()
+
+func _on_external_die() -> void:
+    emit_signal("died")
+    stop()

+

+
+@export var orb_scene: PackedScene
+var current_orb: Node = null
+var arena_root: Node = null

+func setup(p_arena_root: Node, p_orb_scene: PackedScene) -> void:
+    arena_root = p_arena_root
+    orb_scene = p_orb_scene
+    spawn_one()
+
+func spawn_one() -> void:
+    if not arena_root or not orb_scene:
+        return
+    # choose random spawn point from arena's OrbSpawns
+    var spawns = []
+    if arena_root.has_node("OrbSpawns"):
+        for child in arena_root.get_node("OrbSpawns").get_children():
+            if child is Position2D:
+                spawns.append(child.global_position)
+    if spawns.empty():
+        # fallback: center
+        var pos = Vector2(arena_root.position)
+    else:
+        var pos = spawns[randi() % spawns.size()]
+    if current_orb:

+    current_orb = orb_scene.instantiate()
+    current_orb.position = pos
+    arena_root.add_child(current_orb)
+
+func consume_at(grid_pos: Vector2i) -> bool:
+    if not current_orb or not arena_root:

+    var orb_grid = Vector2i(int(round(orb_global.x / TILE_SIZE)), int(round(orb_global.y / TILE_SIZE)))
+    if orb_grid == grid_pos:
+        current_orb.queue_free()
+        current_orb = null
+        spawn_one()
+        return true
+    return false

+    elif position.x > bounds.position.x + bounds.size.x:

+    if position.y < bounds.position.y:

+    elif position.y > bounds.position.y + bounds.size.y:

+extends Node2D
+class_name GameManager
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+const BASE_MOVE_INTERVAL: float = 0.2
+const SPEED_STEP: float = 0.02
+const WIN_SCORE: int = 100
+
+@export var arena_scenes: Array[PackedScene] = []
+@export var snake_scene: PackedScene
+@export var orb_scene: PackedScene
+@export var hazard_scene: PackedScene
+@export var ui_scene: PackedScene
+@export var particle_scene: PackedScene
+
+var current_arena: Node = null
+var arena_index: int = 0
+var orb_manager: OrbManager = null
+var snake: SnakeController = null
+var ui: UIController = null
+var hazards: Array = []
+
+var score: int = 0
+var orbs_eaten: int = 0
+var speed_level: int = 0
+var game_over: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    OS.window_title = "Neon Serpent"
+    _setup_input()
+
+    # preload/exported scenes should be filled in the editor or by the tscn ext_resources
+    # instantiate UI
+    if ui_scene:
+        ui = ui_scene.instantiate() as UIController
+        add_child(ui)
+        ui.update_score(score)
+        ui.update_speed(speed_level)
+
+    # create orb manager
+    orb_manager = OrbManager.new()
+    add_child(orb_manager)
+
+    _load_arena(arena_index)
+    _start_play()
+
+func _setup_input() -> void:
+    var im = InputMap
+    func add_binding(name, keycodes):
+        if not InputMap.has_action(name):
+            InputMap.add_action(name)
+        for kc in keycodes:
+            var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+            ev.physical_keycode = kc
+            InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)
+    # Movement: arrows and WASD
+    add_binding("move_up", [KEY_UP, KEY_W])
+    add_binding("move_down", [KEY_DOWN, KEY_S])
+    add_binding("move_left", [KEY_LEFT, KEY_A])
+    add_binding("move_right", [KEY_RIGHT, KEY_D])
+    add_binding("restart", [KEY_R])
+    add_binding("quit", [KEY_ESCAPE])
+
+func _load_arena(index: int) -> void:
+    if current_arena:
+        current_arena.queue_free()
+        current_arena = null
+    if index < 0 or index >= arena_scenes.size():
+        return
+    current_arena = arena_scenes[index].instantiate()
+    add_child(current_arena)
+
+    # setup orb manager with orb scene
+    orb_manager.setup(current_arena, orb_scene)
+
+    # clear previous hazards and spawn new ones
+    for h in hazards:
+        if h and h.is_inside_tree():
+            h.queue_free()
+    hazards.clear()
+    if current_arena.has_node("HazardSpawns"):
+        for child in current_arena.get_node("HazardSpawns").get_children():
+            if child is Position2D:
+                var hb = hazard_scene.instantiate()
+                hb.position = child.global_position
+                # set bounds if possible
+                if hb.has_method("set"):
+                    hb.bounds = Rect2(0,0,1280,720)
+                current_arena.add_child(hb)
+                hazards.append(hb)
+
+    # spawn snake
+    if snake:
+        snake.queue_free()
+        snake = null
+    if snake_scene:
+        snake = snake_scene.instantiate() as SnakeController
+        add_child(snake)
+        snake.reset_state()
+        snake.connect("moved_to", Callable(self, "_on_snake_moved"))
+        snake.connect("died", Callable(self, "_on_snake_died"))
+
+func _start_play() -> void:
+    score = 0
+    orbs_eaten = 0
+    speed_level = 0
+    game_over = false
+    if ui:
+        ui.hide_game_over()
+        ui.update_score(score)
+        ui.update_speed(speed_level)
+    if snake:
+        snake.start(BASE_MOVE_INTERVAL)
+
+func _on_snake_moved(new_head: Vector2i) -> void:
+    if game_over:
+        return
+    # check wall collision
+    if is_blocked(new_head):
+        _trigger_game_over()
+        return
+    # check hazards
+    for h in hazards:
+        if not h:
+            continue
+        var hpos = h.global_position
+        var hgrid = Vector2i(int(round(hpos.x / TILE_SIZE)), int(round(hpos.y / TILE_SIZE)))
+        if hgrid == new_head:
+            _trigger_game_over()
+            return
+    # check orb
+    if orb_manager.consume_at(new_head):
+        score += 10
+        orbs_eaten += 1
+        if ui:
+            ui.update_score(score)
+        if snake:
+            snake.grow()
+        # every 5 orbs increase speed and pulse background
+        if orbs_eaten % 5 == 0:
+            speed_level += 1
+            if ui:
+                ui.update_speed(speed_level)
+                ui.pulse_background()
+            # speed up snake
+            var new_interval = max(0.05, BASE_MOVE_INTERVAL - speed_level * SPEED_STEP)
+            if snake:
+                snake.start(new_interval)
+        # check win
+        if score >= WIN_SCORE:
+            print("WIN")
+            _advance_arena()
+
+func is_blocked(grid_pos: Vector2i) -> bool:
+    if not current_arena:
+        return false
+    if current_arena.has_node("WallCells"):
+        for child in current_arena.get_node("WallCells").get_children():
+            if child is Position2D:
+                var cpos = child.global_position
+                var cgrid = Vector2i(int(round(cpos.x / TILE_SIZE)), int(round(cpos.y / TILE_SIZE)))
+                if cgrid == grid_pos:
+                    return true
+    return false
+
+func _trigger_game_over() -> void:
+    if game_over:
+        return
+    game_over = true
+    if snake:
+        snake.stop()
+    if ui:
+        ui.show_game_over(score)
+    print("GAME OVER %d" % score)
+
+func _on_snake_died() -> void:
+    _trigger_game_over()
+
+func _advance_arena() -> void:
+    arena_index = (arena_index + 1) % arena_scenes.size()
+    # reset score and speed as we move to next arena
+    score = 0
+    orbs_eaten = 0
+    speed_level = 0
+    _load_arena(arena_index)
+    _start_play()
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if game_over:
+        if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+            _reset_game()
+        elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+            get_tree().quit()
+
+func _reset_game() -> void:
+    # reload same arena
+    for h in hazards:
+        if h and h.is_inside_tree():
+            h.queue_free()
+    hazards.clear()
+    if current_arena:
+        current_arena.queue_free()
+        current_arena = null
+    orb_manager.clear_all()
+    if snake:
+        snake.queue_free()
+        snake = null
+    score = 0
+    orbs_eaten = 0
+    speed_level = 0
+    game_over = false
+    if ui:
+        ui.hide_game_over()
+        ui.update_score(score)
+        ui.update_speed(speed_level)
+    _load_arena(arena_index)
+    _start_play()

notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - 0 (title): game/project.godot (application name) and game/main.gd (OS window title).
  - 1,2 (paddle movement, arrow keys): game/paddle.gd (movement input), game/main.gd (adds input actions).
  - 3,4 (balls drop and bounce): game/main.gd (spawns balls), game/ball.gd (movement, wall/paddle bounce).
  - 5 (spin): game/ball.gd (rotates sprite).
  - 6 (score on bounce): game/ball.gd emits signal bounced -> game/main.gd increments score.
  - 7,8,9 (lives start 3, lose life on miss, display): game/main.gd (lives state, UI, missed signal from ball).
  - 10,11 (win/lose print): game/main.gd prints "WIN" or "GAME OVER" with final score on state change.
  - 12 (R to restart): game/main.gd handles Input to reset state.
  - 13 (Esc to quit): game/main.gd handles quit input.

- State ownership:
  - Main.gd owns global game state: score:int, lives:int, state:String ("playing"/"win"/"game_over"), list of active balls:Array[Node].
  - Paddle.gd owns paddle position and movement speed.
  - Ball.gd owns per-ball velocity:Vector2, angular_velocity:float and handles its own movement and collision checks; it emits signals to Main for scoring/misses.

- Interfaces:
  - Ball.gd:
    - signal bounced()
    - signal missed()
    - func reset(position:Vector2, velocity:Vector2) -> void
  - Main.gd:
    - func spawn_ball() -> void
    - func _on_ball_bounced(ball:Node) -> void
    - func _on_ball_missed(ball:Node) -> void
  - Paddle.gd:
    - export var speed:float
    - no public returns; position read via its global position.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Viewport origin (0,0) at top-left. Positive y down. Sprite nodes are centered. Paddle is placed near bottom center. Ball radius is 16 (sprite 32x32).

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init (_ready): setup input actions, UI, spawn timer, initial state score=0, lives=3.
  - play: balls spawn, move down, bounce on walls/paddle. On bounce, score++.

+extends Area2D
+class_name Ball
+
+signal bounced

+@export var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 200)
+@export var gravity: float = 300.0
+@export var angular_velocity: float = 5.0
+

+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # Apply gravity
+    velocity.y += gravity * delta
+    position += velocity * delta
+    # Spin
+    rotation += angular_velocity * delta
+
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    var r = 16
+    # Wall collisions (left/right)
+    if position.x < r:
+        position.x = r
+        velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
+    elif position.x > view_size.x - r:
+        position.x = view_size.x - r
+        velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
+    # Top
+    if position.y < r:
+        position.y = r
+        velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)
+    # Missed (fell below screen)
+    if position.y > view_size.y + 32:
+        emit_signal("missed")
+        queue_free()
+

+    if area.name == "Paddle":

+            velocity.y = -abs(velocity.y) * 0.9
+            # Add sideways influence based on contact point
+            var offset = position.x - area.global_position.x
+            velocity.x += offset * 3.0
+            # Slight spin change
+            angular_velocity += offset * 0.01
+            emit_signal("bounced")
+
+func is_ball() -> bool:
+    return true
+
+func reset(pos: Vector2, vel: Vector2) -> void:
+    position = pos
+    velocity = vel
+    rotation = 0

--- game/main.gd
+++ game/main.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,187 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+# Main game controller for Bounce Catch
+
+const WIN_SCORE: int = 15
+
+var score: int = 0
+var lives: int = 3
+var state: String = "playing" # "playing", "win", "game_over"
+var balls: Array = []
+
+var PaddleScene = preload("res://paddle.tscn")
+var BallScene = preload("res://ball.tscn")
+
+onready var spawn_timer: Timer = Timer.new()
+onready var hud_layer: CanvasLayer = CanvasLayer.new()
+onready var score_label: Label = Label.new()
+onready var lives_label: Label = Label.new()
+onready var message_label: Label = Label.new()
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Window title
+    if Engine.has_singleton("OS"):
+        OS.set_window_title("Bounce Catch")
+
+    randomize()
+
+    # Ensure input actions
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
+    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
+    var ev2 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
+    var ev3 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
+    var ev4 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+        InputMap.add_action("restart")
+    var evr = InputEventKey.new()
+    evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+        InputMap.add_action("quit")
+    var evq = InputEventKey.new()
+    evq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", evq)
+
+    # Create paddle and place near bottom center
+    var paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
+    paddle.name = "Paddle"
+    add_child(paddle)
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    paddle.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2, view_size.y - 48)
+
+    # Setup HUD
+    hud_layer.name = "HUD"
+    add_child(hud_layer)
+
+    score_label.name = "ScoreLabel"
+    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
+    score_label.position = Vector2(10, 10)
+    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)
+
+    lives_label.name = "LivesLabel"
+    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
+    lives_label.position = Vector2(10, 34)
+    hud_layer.add_child(lives_label)
+
+    message_label.name = "MessageLabel"
+    message_label.text = ""
+    message_label.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2 - 60, view_size.y/2 - 20)
+    message_label.visible = false
+    hud_layer.add_child(message_label)
+
+    # Spawn timer
+    spawn_timer.one_shot = false
+    spawn_timer.wait_time = 1.0
+    spawn_timer.autostart = true
+    spawn_timer.name = "SpawnTimer"
+    add_child(spawn_timer)
+    spawn_timer.start()
+    spawn_timer.timeout.connect(Callable(self, "_on_spawn_timer_timeout"))
+
+    # Start game state
+    score = 0
+    lives = 3
+    state = "playing"
+    update_hud()
+
+func _on_spawn_timer_timeout() -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    spawn_ball()
+
+func spawn_ball() -> void:
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    var b = BallScene.instantiate()
+    b.position = Vector2(randf_range(16, view_size.x - 16), 16)
+    # Give a small random horizontal velocity
+    b.velocity = Vector2(randf_range(-50, 50), 40)
+    add_child(b)
+    balls.append(b)
+    b.add_to_group("balls")
+    # Connect signals
+    if not b.is_connected("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced")):
+        b.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"), [b])
+    if not b.is_connected("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed")):
+        b.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"), [b])
+
+func _on_ball_bounced(ball: Node) -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    score += 1
+    update_hud()
+    # Ensure the ball is tracked
+    if balls.has(ball) == false:
+        balls.append(ball)
+    if score >= WIN_SCORE:
+        handle_win()
+
+func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    # Remove from tracking if present
+    if balls.has(ball):
+        balls.erase(ball)
+    lives -= 1
+    update_hud()
+    if lives <= 0:
+        handle_game_over()
+
+func handle_win() -> void:
+    if state == "win":
+        return
+    state = "win"
+    spawn_timer.stop()
+    message_label.text = "WIN"
+    message_label.visible = true
+    print("WIN")
+    print("SCORE:", score)
+
+func handle_game_over() -> void:
+    if state == "game_over":
+        return
+    state = "game_over"
+    spawn_timer.stop()
+    message_label.text = "GAME OVER"
+    message_label.visible = true
+    print("GAME OVER")
+    print("SCORE:", score)
+
+func update_hud() -> void:
+    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
+    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # Restart or quit handling
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+        restart_game()
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+        get_tree().quit()
+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
+    # Clear existing balls
+    for b in balls.duplicate():
+        if is_instance_valid(b):
+            b.queue_free()
+    balls.clear()
+    # Reset state
+    score = 0
+    lives = 3
+    state = "playing"
+    message_label.visible = false
+    update_hud()
+    spawn_timer.start()

# Main game controller for Bounce Catch

const WIN_SCORE: int = 15

var score: int = 0
var lives: int = 3
var state: String = "playing" # "playing", "win", "game_over"
var balls: Array = []

var PaddleScene = preload("res://paddle.tscn")
var BallScene = preload("res://ball.tscn")

onready var spawn_timer: Timer = Timer.new()
onready var hud_layer: CanvasLayer = CanvasLayer.new()
onready var score_label: Label = Label.new()
onready var lives_label: Label = Label.new()
onready var message_label: Label = Label.new()

func _ready() -> void:
    # Window title
    if Engine.has_singleton("OS"):
        OS.set_window_title("Bounce Catch")

    randomize()

    # Ensure input actions
    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
    var ev2 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)

    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
    var ev3 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
    var ev4 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)

    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
    var evr = InputEventKey.new()
    evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)

    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
    var evq = InputEventKey.new()
    evq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", evq)

    # Create paddle and place near bottom center
    var paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
    paddle.name = "Paddle"
    add_child(paddle)
    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
    paddle.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2, view_size.y - 48)

    # Setup HUD
    hud_layer.name = "HUD"
    add_child(hud_layer)

    score_label.name = "ScoreLabel"
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    score_label.position = Vector2(10, 10)
    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)

    lives_label.name = "LivesLabel"
    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
    lives_label.position = Vector2(10, 34)
    hud_layer.add_child(lives_label)

    message_label.name = "MessageLabel"
    message_label.text = ""
    message_label.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2 - 60, view_size.y/2 - 20)
    message_label.visible = false
    hud_layer.add_child(message_label)

    # Spawn timer
    spawn_timer.one_shot = false
    spawn_timer.wait_time = 1.0
    spawn_timer.autostart = true
    spawn_timer.name = "SpawnTimer"
    add_child(spawn_timer)
    spawn_timer.start()
    spawn_timer.timeout.connect(Callable(self, "_on_spawn_timer_timeout"))

    # Start game state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    state = "playing"
    update_hud()

func _on_spawn_timer_timeout() -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    spawn_ball()

func spawn_ball() -> void:
    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
    var b = BallScene.instantiate()
    b.position = Vector2(randf_range(16, view_size.x - 16), 16)
    # Give a small random horizontal velocity
    b.velocity = Vector2(randf_range(-50, 50), 40)
    add_child(b)
    balls.append(b)
    b.add_to_group("balls")
    # Connect signals
    if not b.is_connected("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced")):
        b.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"), [b])
    if not b.is_connected("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed")):
        b.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"), [b])

func _on_ball_bounced(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    score += 1
    update_hud()
    # Ensure the ball is tracked
    if balls.has(ball) == false:
        balls.append(ball)
    if score >= WIN_SCORE:
        handle_win()

func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    # Remove from tracking if present
    if balls.has(ball):
        balls.erase(ball)
    lives -= 1
    update_hud()
    if lives <= 0:
        handle_game_over()

func handle_win() -> void:
    if state == "win":
        return
    state = "win"
    spawn_timer.stop()
    message_label.text = "WIN"
    message_label.visible = true
    print("WIN")
    print("SCORE:", score)

func handle_game_over() -> void:
    if state == "game_over":
        return
    state = "game_over"
    spawn_timer.stop()
    message_label.text = "GAME OVER"
    message_label.visible = true
    print("GAME OVER")
    print("SCORE:", score)

func update_hud() -> void:
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Restart or quit handling
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        get_tree().quit()

func restart_game() -> void:
    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
    # Clear existing balls
    for b in balls.duplicate():
        if is_instance_valid(b):
            b.queue_free()
    balls.clear()
    # Reset state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    state = "playing"
    message_label.visible = false
    update_hud()
    spawn_timer.start()

const WIN_SCORE: int = 15

var score: int = 0

func _ready() -> void:

    randomize()

    # Ensure input actions
    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
    var ev2 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)

    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
    var ev3 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
    var ev4 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)

    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
    var evr = InputEventKey.new()
    evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)

    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
    var evq = InputEventKey.new()

    # Create paddle and place near bottom center
    var paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()

    # Setup HUD
    hud_layer.name = "HUD"

    lives_label.position = Vector2(10, 34)
    hud_layer.add_child(lives_label)

    message_label.name = "MessageLabel"
    message_label.text = ""
    message_label.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2 - 60, view_size.y/2 - 20)
    message_label.visible = false
    hud_layer.add_child(message_label)

    spawn_timer.wait_time = 1.0
    spawn_timer.autostart = true
    spawn_timer.name = "SpawnTimer"

    b.position = Vector2(randf_range(16, view_size.x - 16), 16)

    add_child(b)
    balls.append(b)
    b.add_to_group("balls")
    # Connect signals
    if not b.is_connected("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced")):
        b.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"), [b])
    if not b.is_connected("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed")):
        b.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"), [b])

func _on_ball_bounced(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    score += 1
    update_hud()
    # Ensure the ball is tracked
    if balls.has(ball) == false:
        balls.append(ball)
    if score >= WIN_SCORE:
        handle_win()

func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    # Remove from tracking if present
    if balls.has(ball):

    lives -= 1
    update_hud()
    if lives <= 0:
        handle_game_over()

func handle_win() -> void:
    if state == "win":
        return
    state = "win"
    spawn_timer.stop()
    message_label.text = "WIN"
    message_label.visible = true

func handle_game_over() -> void:
    if state == "game_over":

    state = "game_over"

func update_hud() -> void:

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Restart or quit handling

        get_tree().quit()

func restart_game() -> void:
    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
    # Clear existing balls
    for b in balls.duplicate():
        if is_instance_valid(b):
            b.queue_free()
    balls.clear()
    # Reset state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    state = "playing"
    message_label.visible = false
    update_hud()

class_name Ball

signal bounced
signal missed

@export var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 200)
@export var gravity: float = 300.0
@export var angular_velocity: float = 5.0

onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D

func _ready() -> void:

    connect("area_entered", Callable(self, "_on_area_entered"))

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Apply gravity
    velocity.y += gravity * delta
    position += velocity * delta
    # Spin
    rotation += angular_velocity * delta

    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
    var r = 16
    # Wall collisions (left/right)
    if position.x < r:
        position.x = r
        velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
    elif position.x > view_size.x - r:
        position.x = view_size.x - r
        velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
    # Top
    if position.y < r:
        position.y = r
        velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)

# Main game controller for Bounce Catch

const WIN_SCORE: int = 15

var score: int = 0
var lives: int = 3
var state: String = "playing" # "playing", "win", "game_over"
var balls: Array = []

var PaddleScene = preload("res://paddle.tscn")
var BallScene = preload("res://ball.tscn")

onready var spawn_timer: Timer = Timer.new()
onready var hud_layer: CanvasLayer = CanvasLayer.new()
onready var score_label: Label = Label.new()
onready var lives_label: Label = Label.new()
onready var message_label: Label = Label.new()

func _ready() -> void:
    # Window title
    if Engine.has_singleton("OS"):
        OS.set_window_title("Bounce Catch")

    randomize()

    # Ensure input actions
    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
    var ev2 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)

    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
    var ev3 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
    var ev4 = InputEventKey.new()
    ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)

    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
        InputMap.add_action("restart")
    var evr = InputEventKey.new()
    evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)

    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
        InputMap.add_action("quit")
    var evq = InputEventKey.new()
    evq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", evq)

    # Create paddle and place near bottom center
    var paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
    paddle.name = "Paddle"
    add_child(paddle)
    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
    paddle.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2, view_size.y - 48)

    # Setup HUD
    hud_layer.name = "HUD"
    add_child(hud_layer)

    score_label.name = "ScoreLabel"
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    score_label.position = Vector2(10, 10)
    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)

    lives_label.name = "LivesLabel"
    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
    lives_label.position = Vector2(10, 34)
    hud_layer.add_child(lives_label)

    message_label.name = "MessageLabel"
    message_label.text = ""
    message_label.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2 - 60, view_size.y/2 - 20)
    message_label.visible = false
    hud_layer.add_child(message_label)

    # Spawn timer
    spawn_timer.one_shot = false
    spawn_timer.wait_time = 1.0
    spawn_timer.autostart = true
    spawn_timer.name = "SpawnTimer"
    add_child(spawn_timer)
    spawn_timer.start()
    spawn_timer.timeout.connect(Callable(self, "_on_spawn_timer_timeout"))

    # Start game state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    state = "playing"
    update_hud()

func _on_spawn_timer_timeout() -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    spawn_ball()

func spawn_ball() -> void:
    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
    var b = BallScene.instantiate()
    b.position = Vector2(randf_range(16, view_size.x - 16), 16)
    # Give a small random horizontal velocity
    b.velocity = Vector2(randf_range(-50, 50), 40)
    add_child(b)
    balls.append(b)
    b.add_to_group("balls")
    # Connect signals
    if not b.is_connected("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced")):
        b.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"), [b])
    if not b.is_connected("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed")):
        b.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"), [b])

func _on_ball_bounced(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    score += 1
    update_hud()
    # Ensure the ball is tracked
    if balls.has(ball) == false:
        balls.append(ball)
    if score >= WIN_SCORE:
        handle_win()

func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
    if state != "playing":
        return
    # Remove from tracking if present
    if balls.has(ball):
        balls.erase(ball)
    lives -= 1
    update_hud()
    if lives <= 0:
        handle_game_over()

func handle_win() -> void:
    if state == "win":
        return
    state = "win"
    spawn_timer.stop()
    message_label.text = "WIN"
    message_label.visible = true
    print("WIN")
    print("SCORE:", score)

func handle_game_over() -> void:
    if state == "game_over":
        return
    state = "game_over"
    spawn_timer.stop()
    message_label.text = "GAME OVER"
    message_label.visible = true
    print("GAME OVER")
    print("SCORE:", score)

func update_hud() -> void:
    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # Restart or quit handling
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        get_tree().quit()

func restart_game() -> void:
    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
    # Clear existing balls
    for b in balls.duplicate():
        if is_instance_valid(b):
            b.queue_free()
    balls.clear()
    # Reset state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    state = "playing"
    message_label.visible = false
    update_hud()
    spawn_timer.start()

func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:

    lives -= 1
    update_hud()

func handle_win() -> void:

func update_hud() -> void:

func _process(delta: float) -> void:

func restart_game() -> void:
    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
    # Clear existing balls
    for b in balls.duplicate():
        if is_instance_valid(b):

    score = 0
    lives = 3

notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - game/__init__.py: package init only (empty).
  - game/pong.py: owns all gameplay, rendering, input, state, reset, and quit behavior implementing requirements [0-13].

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - Game class in game/pong.py owns all state: left/right paddle Rects and velocities, ball Rect and velocity (vx, vy), scores (int), game_over (bool), winner (int or None).
  - Public methods:
    - Game.reset() -> None : resets scores (optionally), positions, velocities, and unfreezes.
    - Game.serve(direction: int or None) -> None : place ball center and set vx,vy diagonally; direction None -> random.
    - Game.update(dt: float) -> None : advances ball/paddle positions and checks collisions, scoring and win.
    - Game.handle_events() -> bool : processes pygame events; returns False to quit.
    - Game.draw(screen) -> None : draws paddles, ball, scores, controls, and win message.

- Input -> action -> state -> visible feedback:
  - KEYDOWN/held:
    - W/S control left paddle up/down (continuous via key.get_pressed()).
    - UP/DOWN arrow control right paddle.
    - R key resets (KEYDOWN).
    - Escape quits (KEYDOWN).
  - Actions update paddle positions clamped to screen; ball moves by vx,vy*dt; collisions reverse directions; scoring increments score and calls serve(); when score reaches 5 set game_over True and freeze movement.
  - Visual feedback via drawing shapes and text each frame; [EVENT] lines printed to stdout on score and win.

- Coordinate convention: top-left (0,0), y increases downward. Positions use pygame.Rect for bounds.

- Lifecycle:
  - init: pygame.init(), create Game(), Game.reset() (starts ball moving).
  - run: loop: handle_events -> update(dt) if not game_over -> draw -> pygame.display.flip()
  - win: when score reaches 5, game_over True, movement stops; winner shown.
  - reset: pressing R calls Game.reset() which restores scores to 0 and restarts play.
  - quit: ESC or window close exits main loop and pygame.quit().

I will now create the promised files.

+import sys
+import os
+import random
+import pygame
+
+# Ensure module imports work when running as a module or script
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+# Game constants matching the Plan
+WIDTH = 800
+HEIGHT = 600
+FPS = 60
+
+PADDLE_WIDTH = 10
+PADDLE_HEIGHT = 100
+PADDLE_SPEED = 400  # pixels per second
+BALL_SIZE = 12
+BALL_SPEED = 300  # base speed in pixels per second
+WIN_SCORE = 5
+
+FONT_SIZE = 32
+SMALL_FONT_SIZE = 20
+
+class Game:
+    """Encapsulates all game state and behavior.
+
+    Public methods:
+      - reset() -> None
+      - serve(direction: int|None) -> None  # direction: -1 left, 1 right, None random
+      - handle_events() -> bool  # returns False to quit
+      - update(dt: float) -> None
+      - draw(screen) -> None
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int):
+        self.width = width
+        self.height = height
+        # paddles as pygame.Rect
+        pad_x_offset = 20
+        self.left_paddle = pygame.Rect(pad_x_offset, (height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2, PADDLE_WIDTH, PADDLE_HEIGHT)
+        self.right_paddle = pygame.Rect(width - pad_x_offset - PADDLE_WIDTH, (height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2, PADDLE_WIDTH, PADDLE_HEIGHT)
+        self.ball = pygame.Rect((width - BALL_SIZE)//2, (height - BALL_SIZE)//2, BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE)
+        # velocities
+        self.ball_vx = 0.0
+        self.ball_vy = 0.0
+        # scores
+        self.score1 = 0
+        self.score2 = 0
+        # game state
+        self.game_over = False
+        self.winner = None  # 1 or 2
+
+        # fonts (initialized after pygame.init typically)
+        self.font = pygame.font.Font(None, FONT_SIZE)
+        self.small_font = pygame.font.Font(None, SMALL_FONT_SIZE)
+
+        # start play
+        self.reset()
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        """Reset scores, positions, velocities and unfreeze the game.
+        As required: pressing R resets both scores to 0, places the ball in the center, and unfreezes the game.
+        """
+        self.score1 = 0
+        self.score2 = 0
+        self.game_over = False
+        self.winner = None
+        # reset positions
+        self.left_paddle.y = (self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2
+        self.right_paddle.y = (self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2
+        self.ball.x = (self.width - BALL_SIZE)//2

                self.ball_vx = 0
                self.ball_vy = 0
                return
            self.serve(direction=-1)

    def draw(self, screen) -> None:
        """Render the current game state to the provided screen surface."""
        # background
        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))

        # center dashed line
        for y in range(0, self.height, 20):
            pygame.draw.line(screen, (200, 200, 200), (self.width//2, y), (self.width//2, y+10), 2)

            msg_surf = self.font.render(msg, True, (255, 220, 0))
            screen.blit(msg_surf, (self.width//2 - msg_surf.get_width()//2, self.height//2 - msg_surf.get_height()//2))

    pygame.init()

import sys
import os
import random
import pygame

# Ensure module imports work when running as a module or script
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

# Game constants matching the Plan
WIDTH = 800
HEIGHT = 600
FPS = 60

PADDLE_WIDTH = 10
PADDLE_HEIGHT = 100
PADDLE_SPEED = 400  # pixels per second
BALL_SIZE = 12
BALL_SPEED = 300  # base speed in pixels per second
WIN_SCORE = 5

FONT_SIZE = 32
SMALL_FONT_SIZE = 20

class Game:
    """Encapsulates all game state and behavior.

    Public methods:
      - reset() -> None
      - serve(direction: int|None) -> None  # direction: -1 left, 1 right, None random
      - handle_events() -> bool  # returns False to quit
      - update(dt: float) -> None
      - draw(screen) -> None
    """

    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        # paddles as pygame.Rect
        pad_x_offset = 20
        self.left_paddle = pygame.Rect(pad_x_offset, (height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2, PADDLE_WIDTH, PADDLE_HEIGHT)
        self.right_paddle = pygame.Rect(width - pad_x_offset - PADDLE_WIDTH, (height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2, PADDLE_WIDTH, PADDLE_HEIGHT)
        self.ball = pygame.Rect((width - BALL_SIZE)//2, (height - BALL_SIZE)//2, BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE)
        # velocities
        self.ball_vx = 0.0
        self.ball_vy = 0.0
        # scores
        self.score1 = 0
        self.score2 = 0
        # game state
        self.game_over = False
        self.winner = None  # 1 or 2

        # fonts (initialized after pygame.init typically)
        self.font = pygame.font.Font(None, FONT_SIZE)
        self.small_font = pygame.font.Font(None, SMALL_FONT_SIZE)

        # start play
        self.reset()

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Reset scores, positions, velocities and unfreeze the game.
        As required: pressing R resets both scores to 0, places the ball in the center, and unfreezes the game.
        """
        self.score1 = 0
        self.score2 = 0
        self.game_over = False
        self.winner = None
        # reset positions
        self.left_paddle.y = (self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2
        self.right_paddle.y = (self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT)//2
        self.ball.x = (self.width - BALL_SIZE)//2
        self.ball.y = (self.height - BALL_SIZE)//2
        self.serve(direction=None)

    def serve(self, direction=None) -> None:
        """Place ball in center and give it an initial diagonal velocity.
        direction: -1 (left), 1 (right), or None for random
        """
        self.ball.x = (self.width - BALL_SIZE)//2
        self.ball.y = (self.height - BALL_SIZE)//2
        if direction not in (-1, 1):
            direction = random.choice([-1, 1])
        vert = random.choice([-1, 1])
        self.ball_vx = BALL_SPEED * direction
        self.ball_vy = BALL_SPEED * 0.6 * vert  # make diagonal but not 45deg

    def handle_events(self) -> bool:
        """Process pygame events. Returns False when the game should quit."""
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                return False
            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    return False
                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                    # Reset game
                    self.reset()
        return True

    def update(self, dt: float) -> None:
        """Advance game state by dt seconds. Movement is frozen when game_over is True."""
        if self.game_over:
            return

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        # Left paddle: W/S
        if keys[pygame.K_w]:
            self.left_paddle.y -= int(PADDLE_SPEED * dt)
        if keys[pygame.K_s]:
            self.left_paddle.y += int(PADDLE_SPEED * dt)
        # Right paddle: UP/DOWN
        if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
            self.right_paddle.y -= int(PADDLE_SPEED * dt)
        if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
            self.right_paddle.y += int(PADDLE_SPEED * dt)

        # Clamp paddles to screen
        self.left_paddle.y = max(0, min(self.left_paddle.y, self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT))
        self.right_paddle.y = max(0, min(self.right_paddle.y, self.height - PADDLE_HEIGHT))

        # Move ball
        self.ball.x += int(self.ball_vx * dt)
        self.ball.y += int(self.ball_vy * dt)

        # Ball collision with top/bottom
        if self.ball.top <= 0:
            self.ball.top = 0
            self.ball_vy *= -1
        if self.ball.bottom >= self.height:
            self.ball.bottom = self.height
            self.ball_vy *= -1

        # Ball collision with paddles
        if self.ball.colliderect(self.left_paddle) and self.ball_vx < 0:
            self.ball.left = self.left_paddle.right
            self.ball_vx *= -1
            # tweak vertical velocity based on contact point
            offset = (self.ball.centery - self.left_paddle.centery) / (PADDLE_HEIGHT/2)
            self.ball_vy = BALL_SPEED * 0.8 * offset
        if self.ball.colliderect(self.right_paddle) and self.ball_vx > 0:
            self.ball.right = self.right_paddle.left
            self.ball_vx *= -1
            offset = (self.ball.centery - self.right_paddle.centery) / (PADDLE_HEIGHT/2)
            self.ball_vy = BALL_SPEED * 0.8 * offset

        # Scoring: ball goes off left or right
        if self.ball.right < 0:
            # Player 2 scores
            self.score2 += 1
            print(f"[EVENT] SCORE: P2 {self.score2}")
            if self.score2 >= WIN_SCORE:
                self.game_over = True
                self.winner = 2
                print("[EVENT] WIN: Player 2")
                # freeze velocities
                self.ball_vx = 0
                self.ball_vy = 0
                return
            self.serve(direction=1)
        elif self.ball.left > self.width:
            # Player 1 scores
            self.score1 += 1
            print(f"[EVENT] SCORE: P1 {self.score1}")
            if self.score1 >= WIN_SCORE:
                self.game_over = True
                self.winner = 1
                print("[EVENT] WIN: Player 1")
                self.ball_vx = 0
                self.ball_vy = 0
                return
            self.serve(direction=-1)

    def draw(self, screen) -> None:
        """Render the current game state to the provided screen surface."""
        # background
        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))

        # center dashed line
        for y in range(0, self.height, 20):
            pygame.draw.line(screen, (200, 200, 200), (self.width//2, y), (self.width//2, y+10), 2)

        # paddles
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (255, 255, 255), self.left_paddle)
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (255, 255, 255), self.right_paddle)

        # ball
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), self.ball)

        # scores and controls
        score1_surf = self.font.render(str(self.score1), True, (255, 255, 255))
        score2_surf = self.font.render(str(self.score2), True, (255, 255, 255))
        screen.blit(score1_surf, (self.width//4 - score1_surf.get_width()//2, 20))
        screen.blit(score2_surf, (3*self.width//4 - score2_surf.get_width()//2, 20))

        controls = "W/S: Left    UP/DOWN: Right    R: Reset    Esc: Quit"
        ctrl_surf = self.small_font.render(controls, True, (180, 180, 180))
        screen.blit(ctrl_surf, (self.width//2 - ctrl_surf.get_width()//2, 5))

        # Winner message
        if self.game_over and self.winner is not None:
            msg = f"Player {self.winner} wins! Press R to restart"
            msg_surf = self.font.render(msg, True, (255, 220, 0))
            screen.blit(msg_surf, (self.width//2 - msg_surf.get_width()//2, self.height//2 - msg_surf.get_height()//2))


def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Pong")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    game = Game(WIDTH, HEIGHT)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        running = game.handle_events()
        game.update(dt)
        game.draw(screen)
        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

- Requirement -> owning files:

  - Controls text (12): game/snake_game.py.

- State ownership and method signatures:
  - Snake (game/snake.py)
    - class Snake:
      - __init__(self, initial_body: list[tuple[int,int]], direction: tuple[int,int])
      - move(self, grow: bool=False) -> tuple[int,int]  # returns new head position
      - set_direction(self, dx: int, dy: int) -> None
      - head(self) -> tuple[int,int]
      - occupies(self) -> set[tuple[int,int]]  # positions occupied
      - check_self_collision(self, next_head: tuple[int,int], grow: bool=False) -> bool
  - Food (game/food.py)
    - class Food:
      - __init__(self, grid_size: int)
      - respawn(self, occupied: set[tuple[int,int]]) -> None
      - position (attribute): tuple[int,int]
  - Snake_game (game/snake_game.py)
    - init_game() -> None (creates Snake, Food, score, game_over flag)
    - main loop handles pygame events, calls snake.move(grow) each tick unless game_over.

- Input -> action -> state/rules -> visible feedback:
  - KEYDOWN arrow -> snake_game.set_direction -> Snake.set_direction checks no-reverse -> updates snake.dx/dy state -> next tick snake.move() changes body -> render shows new head position.
  - Tick (Clock at FPS=10) -> if not game_over call snake.move() -> collision checks with walls and self -> if collision: set game_over True and print "GAME OVER" -> render freeze and show "GAME OVER" and final score.
  - When snake.head == food.position -> grow=True for that move, score +=1, print(score) to console, food.respawn(occupied).
  - R key when game_over or anytime -> init_game() resets all state to initial values (fresh snake, score 0).
  - Escape -> pygame.QUIT -> exit program.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Grid coordinates are (x,y) with 0 <= x,y < GRID_SIZE.
  - Pixel mapping: pixel_x = x * CELL_SIZE; pixel_y = TOP_MARGIN + y * CELL_SIZE.
  - Snake and food sizes are CELL_SIZE squares; the playable area is GRID_SIZE*CELL_SIZE by GRID_SIZE*CELL_SIZE.

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init_game(): create initial snake (3 segments centered, moving right), spawn food not overlapping snake, score=0, game_over=False.
  - play: main loop updates per tick, handles inputs, updates state, renders.
  - terminal: on collision set game_over=True, freeze updates until R.
  - reset: init_game restores all objects and counters.
  - quit: Escape or window close triggers pygame.quit() and sys.exit().

+from typing import List, Tuple, Set
+
+class Snake:
+    """Manages snake body, movement, growth, and self-collision."""
+    def __init__(self, initial_body: List[Tuple[int,int]], direction: Tuple[int,int]):
+        # body is a list of (x,y) with head at index 0
+        self.body: List[Tuple[int,int]] = list(initial_body)
+        self.dx, self.dy = direction
+
+    def head(self) -> Tuple[int,int]:
+        return self.body[0]
+
+    def occupies(self) -> Set[Tuple[int,int]]:
+        return set(self.body)
+
+    def set_direction(self, dx: int, dy: int) -> None:
+        # prevent reversing into itself
+        if (dx, dy) == (-self.dx, -self.dy):
+            return
+        self.dx, self.dy = dx, dy
+
+    def next_head(self) -> Tuple[int,int]:
+        hx, hy = self.head()
+        return (hx + self.dx, hy + self.dy)
+
+    def check_self_collision(self, next_head: Tuple[int,int], grow: bool=False) -> bool:
+        # If growing, the tail won't move, so colliding with any part is fatal.
+        # If not growing, moving into the current tail cell is allowed (it will vacate).
+        if grow:
+            return next_head in self.body

+from typing import List, Tuple, Set
+
+class Snake:
+    """Manages snake body, movement, growth, and self-collision."""
+    def __init__(self, initial_body: List[Tuple[int,int]], direction: Tuple[int,int]):
+        # body is a list of (x,y) with head at index 0
+        self.body: List[Tuple[int,int]] = list(initial_body)
+        self.dx, self.dy = direction
+
+    def head(self) -> Tuple[int,int]:
+        return self.body[0]
+
+    def occupies(self) -> Set[Tuple[int,int]]:
+        return set(self.body)
+
+    def set_direction(self, dx: int, dy: int) -> None:
+        # prevent reversing into itself
+        if (dx, dy) == (-self.dx, -self.dy):
+            return
+        self.dx, self.dy = dx, dy
+
+    def next_head(self) -> Tuple[int,int]:
+        hx, hy = self.head()
+        return (hx + self.dx, hy + self.dy)
+
+    def check_self_collision(self, next_head: Tuple[int,int], grow: bool=False) -> bool:
+        # If growing, the tail won't move, so colliding with any part is fatal.
+        # If not growing, moving into the current tail cell is allowed (it will vacate).
+        if grow:
+            return next_head in self.body
+        else:
+            # allowed to move into tail position
+            tail = self.body[-1]
+            if next_head == tail:
+                return False
+            return next_head in self.body
+
+    def move(self, grow: bool=False) -> Tuple[int,int]:
+        nh = self.next_head()
+        self.body.insert(0, nh)
+        if not grow:
+            self.body.pop()
+        return nh
+
+    def reset(self, initial_body: List[Tuple[int,int]], direction: Tuple[int,int]):
+        self.body = list(initial_body)
+        self.dx, self.dy = direction
