+    elif not is_on_floor():
+        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("jump"):
+            animation_player.play("jump")
+    elif abs(velocity.x) > 10:
+        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("walk"):
+            animation_player.play("walk")
+    else:
+        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("idle"):
+            animation_player.play("idle")
+
+func _do_punch() -> void:
+    _can_punch = false
+    _is_punching = true
+    _punch_timer = punch_cooldown
+    print("PUNCH")
+
+    var duration = punch_duration_fallback
+    if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("punch"):
+        duration = max(duration, animation_player.get_animation("punch").length)
+        animation_player.play("punch")
+
+    if punch_area:
+        punch_area.monitoring = true
+        await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
+        if punch_area:
+            punch_area.monitoring = false
+
+    await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
+    _is_punching = false

+func _on_punch_area_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
+    if body == self:

+    if not _is_punching:

+    if body.has_method("take_damage"):

+        var knockback = Vector2(kb_sign * punch_knockback, -50)

+func take_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:

+        var prev = sprite.modulate
+        sprite.modulate = Color(1,0.6,0.6)
+        await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
+        sprite.modulate = prev
+    if health <= 0:
+        emit_signal("died")

+func reset(pos: Vector2) -> void:
+    health = max_health
+    emit_signal("health_changed", health)
+    global_position = pos
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    _can_punch = true
+    _is_punching = false

+++ game/game_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+# GameManager handles input setup, HUD updates, win/lose, restart and quit
+
+@onready var player: Node = $Player
+@onready var rival: Node = $Rival
+@onready var hud_player_bar_fg: ColorRect = $HUD/PlayerBar/Foreground
+@onready var hud_rival_bar_fg: ColorRect = $HUD/RivalBar/Foreground
+@onready var win_label: Label = $HUD/WinLabel
+
+var player_start_pos: Vector2
+var rival_start_pos: Vector2
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # set window title via project settings (project.godot) should apply, but ensure in case
+    if ProjectSettings.has_setting("application/config/name"):
+        var name = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/name")
+        if name:
+            OS.set_window_title(str(name))
+
+    _ensure_input_actions()
+
+    # cache start positions
+    player_start_pos = player.global_position
+    rival_start_pos = rival.global_position
+
+    # connect signals
+    if player.has_signal("health_changed"):
+        player.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_health_changed"))
+    if player.has_signal("died"):
+        player.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_died"))
+    if rival.has_signal("health_changed"):
+        rival.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_health_changed"))
+    if rival.has_signal("died"):
+        rival.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_died"))
+
+    # initialize HUD
+    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
+    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)
+    win_label.visible = false
+
+func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
+    # Define actions and bind keys (arrows, space, R, Escape)
+    var a_left = "ui_left"
+    var a_right = "ui_right"
+    var a_up = "ui_up"
+    var a_attack = "ui_attack"
+    var a_restart = "restart"
+    var a_quit = "quit"
+
+    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_LEFT)
+    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_A)
+    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_RIGHT)
+    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_D)
+    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_UP)
+    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_W)
+    _add_key_action(a_attack, KEY_SPACE)
+    _add_key_action(a_restart, KEY_R)
+    _add_key_action(a_quit, KEY_ESCAPE)
+
+func _add_key_action(name: String, keycode: int) -> void:
+    if not InputMap.has_action(name):
+        InputMap.add_action(name)
+    var ev := InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = keycode
+    InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # handle restart and quit input here for prints/behavior
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+        print("RESTART")
+        restart_game()
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+        print("QUIT")
+        get_tree().quit()
+
+func _on_player_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
+    var pct = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
+    hud_player_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+func _on_rival_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
+    var pct = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
+    hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+func _on_player_died() -> void:
+    # player died -> GAME OVER
+    win_label.text = "GAME OVER"
+    win_label.visible = true
+    print("GAME OVER")
+    get_tree().paused = true
+
+func _on_rival_died() -> void:
+    win_label.text = "WIN"
+    win_label.visible = true
+    print("WIN")
+    get_tree().paused = true
+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # hide win text
+    win_label.visible = false
+    # reset fighters
+    if player.has_method("reset"):
+        player.reset(player_start_pos)
+    if rival.has_method("reset"):
+        rival.reset(rival_start_pos)
+    # unpause
+    get_tree().paused = false
+    # refresh HUD
+    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
+    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)

extends CharacterBody2D
class_name Player

signal health_changed(new_health:int)
signal died()

@export var speed:float = 180.0
@export var jump_velocity:float = 350.0
@export var gravity:float = 900.0
@export var punch_damage:int = 10
@export var punch_cooldown:float = 0.6 # seconds between punches
@export var punch_knockback:float = 200.0
@export var punch_range:float = 40.0 # fallback range if PunchArea missing
@export var max_health:int = 100

@export var punch_duration_fallback:float = 0.25

var health:int
var facing:int = 1 # 1 = right, -1 = left

var _can_punch:bool = true
var _is_punching:bool = false
var _punch_timer:float = 0.0

@onready var sprite:Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
@onready var animation_player:AnimationPlayer = $AnimationPlayer
@onready var punch_area:Area2D = $PunchArea

func _ready() -> void:
    health = max_health
    if punch_area:
        punch_area.monitoring = false
        punch_area.body_entered.connect(Callable(self, "_on_punch_area_body_entered"))

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    if get_tree().paused:
        return

    # gravity
    if not is_on_floor():
        velocity.y += gravity * delta
    else:
        if velocity.y > 0:
            velocity.y = 0

    var dir = 0
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left"):
        dir -= 1
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right"):
        dir += 1

    if dir != 0:
        velocity.x = dir * speed
        facing = dir
        if dir < 0:
            sprite.flip_h = true
            print("MOVE LEFT")
        else:
            sprite.flip_h = false
            print("MOVE RIGHT")
    else:
        velocity.x = lerp(velocity.x, 0, 0.2)

    # jumping
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") and is_on_floor():
        velocity.y = -jump_velocity
        print("JUMP")

    # punching
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_attack") and _can_punch and not _is_punching:
        _do_punch()

    # update punch timer
    if not _can_punch:
        _punch_timer -= delta
        if _punch_timer <= 0:
            _can_punch = true

    # apply movement (CharacterBody2D uses its built-in velocity property)
    move_and_slide()

    # animations (if provided by designer)
    if _is_punching:
        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("punch"):
            if not animation_player.is_playing():
                animation_player.play("punch")
    elif not is_on_floor():
        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("jump"):
            animation_player.play("jump")
    elif abs(velocity.x) > 10:
        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("walk"):
            animation_player.play("walk")
    else:
        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("idle"):
            animation_player.play("idle")

func _do_punch() -> void:
    _can_punch = false
    _is_punching = true
    _punch_timer = punch_cooldown
    print("PUNCH")

    var duration = punch_duration_fallback
    if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("punch"):
        duration = max(duration, animation_player.get_animation("punch").length)
        animation_player.play("punch")

    if punch_area:
        punch_area.monitoring = true
        await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
        if punch_area:
            punch_area.monitoring = false

    await get_tree().create_timer(duration).timeout
    _is_punching = false

func _on_punch_area_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
    if body == self:
        return
    if not _is_punching:
        return
    if body.has_method("take_damage"):
        var kb_dir = (body.global_position.x - global_position.x)
        var kb_sign = 1 if kb_dir >= 0 else -1
        var knockback = Vector2(kb_sign * punch_knockback, -50)
        body.take_damage(punch_damage, knockback)

func take_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
    health = max(0, health - amount)
    emit_signal("health_changed", health)
    velocity += knockback
    if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("hit"):
        animation_player.play("hit")
    else:
        var prev = sprite.modulate
        sprite.modulate = Color(1,0.6,0.6)
        await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
        sprite.modulate = prev
    if health <= 0:
        emit_signal("died")

func reset(pos: Vector2) -> void:
    health = max_health
    emit_signal("health_changed", health)
    global_position = pos
    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
    _can_punch = true
    _is_punching = false
    if punch_area:
        punch_area.monitoring = false

extends Node2D

# GameManager handles input setup, HUD updates, win/lose, restart and quit

@onready var player: Node = $Player
@onready var rival: Node = $Rival
var hud_player_bar_fg: ColorRect
var hud_rival_bar_fg: ColorRect
@onready var win_label: Label = $HUD/WinLabel

var player_start_pos: Vector2
var rival_start_pos: Vector2

func _ready() -> void:
    # set window title via project settings (project.godot) should apply, but ensure in case
    if ProjectSettings.has_setting("application/config/name"):
        var name = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/name")
        if name:
            DisplayServer.window_set_title(str(name))

    _ensure_input_actions()

    # cache start positions
    player_start_pos = player.global_position
    rival_start_pos = rival.global_position

    # find HUD elements safely (use get_node_or_null to avoid tscn ordering issues)
    var hud := get_node_or_null("HUD")
    if hud:
        hud_player_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("PlayerBar/Foreground") else null
        hud_rival_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("RivalBar/Foreground") else null
        # If missing, create simple ColorRect placeholders so updates won't error
        if not hud_player_bar_fg:
            var pb := hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar")
            if not pb:
                pb = ColorRect.new()
                pb.name = "PlayerBar"
                pb.rect_position = Vector2(50,10)
                pb.rect_size = Vector2(300,24)
                hud.add_child(pb)
            hud_player_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_player_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_player_bar_fg.color = Color(1,0,0)
            hud_player_bar_fg.rect_size = Vector2(300,24)
            pb.add_child(hud_player_bar_fg)
        if not hud_rival_bar_fg:
            var rb := hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar")
            if not rb:
                rb = ColorRect.new()
                rb.name = "RivalBar"
                rb.rect_position = Vector2(450,10)
                rb.rect_size = Vector2(300,24)
                hud.add_child(rb)
            hud_rival_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_rival_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_rival_bar_fg.color = Color(0,0,1)
            hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_size = Vector2(300,24)
            rb.add_child(hud_rival_bar_fg)

    # connect signals
    if player.has_signal("health_changed"):
        player.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_health_changed"))
    if player.has_signal("died"):
        player.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_died"))
    if rival.has_signal("health_changed"):
        rival.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_health_changed"))
    if rival.has_signal("died"):
        rival.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_died"))

    # initialize HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)
    if win_label:
        win_label.visible = false

func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
    # Define actions and bind keys (arrows, space, R, Escape)
    var a_left = "ui_left"
    var a_right = "ui_right"
    var a_up = "ui_up"
    var a_attack = "ui_attack"
    var a_restart = "restart"
    var a_quit = "quit"

    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_LEFT)
    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_A)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_RIGHT)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_D)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_UP)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_W)
    _add_key_action(a_attack, KEY_SPACE)
    _add_key_action(a_restart, KEY_R)
    _add_key_action(a_quit, KEY_ESCAPE)

func _add_key_action(name: String, keycode: int) -> void:
    if not InputMap.has_action(name):
        InputMap.add_action(name)
    var ev := InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = keycode
    InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # handle restart and quit input here for prints/behavior
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        print("RESTART")
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

func _on_player_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
    hud_player_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)

func _on_rival_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
    hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)

func _on_player_died() -> void:
    # player died -> GAME OVER
    win_label.text = "GAME OVER"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("GAME OVER")
    get_tree().paused = true

func _on_rival_died() -> void:
    win_label.text = "WIN"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("WIN")
    get_tree().paused = true

func restart_game() -> void:
    # hide win text
    win_label.visible = false
    # reset fighters
    if player.has_method("reset"):
        player.reset(player_start_pos)
    if rival.has_method("reset"):
        rival.reset(rival_start_pos)
    # unpause
    get_tree().paused = false
    # refresh HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)

extends Node2D

# GameManager handles input setup, HUD updates, win/lose, restart and quit

@onready var player: Node = $Player
@onready var rival: Node = $Rival
var hud_player_bar_fg: ColorRect
var hud_rival_bar_fg: ColorRect
@onready var win_label: Label = $HUD/WinLabel

var player_start_pos: Vector2
var rival_start_pos: Vector2

var hud_player_bar_full_width: float = 300.0
var hud_rival_bar_full_width: float = 300.0

func _ready() -> void:
    # set window title via project settings (project.godot) should apply, but ensure in case
    if ProjectSettings.has_setting("application/config/name"):
        var name = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/name")
        if name:
            DisplayServer.window_set_title(str(name))

    _ensure_input_actions()

    # cache start positions
    player_start_pos = player.global_position
    rival_start_pos = rival.global_position

    # find HUD elements safely (use get_node_or_null to avoid tscn ordering issues)
    var hud := get_node_or_null("HUD")
    if hud:
        hud_player_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("PlayerBar/Foreground") else null
        hud_rival_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("RivalBar/Foreground") else null
        # If missing, create simple ColorRect placeholders so updates won't error
        if not hud_player_bar_fg:
            var pb := hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar")
            if not pb:
                pb = ColorRect.new()
                pb.name = "PlayerBar"
                pb.rect_position = Vector2(50,10)
                hud.add_child(pb)
            hud_player_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_player_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_player_bar_fg.color = Color(1,0,0)
            pb.add_child(hud_player_bar_fg)
        if not hud_rival_bar_fg:
            var rb := hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar")
            if not rb:
                rb = ColorRect.new()
                rb.name = "RivalBar"
                rb.rect_position = Vector2(450,10)
                hud.add_child(rb)
            hud_rival_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_rival_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_rival_bar_fg.color = Color(0,0,1)
            rb.add_child(hud_rival_bar_fg)

    # connect signals
    if player.has_signal("health_changed"):
        player.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_health_changed"))
    if player.has_signal("died"):
        player.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_died"))
    if rival.has_signal("health_changed"):
        rival.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_health_changed"))
    if rival.has_signal("died"):
        rival.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_died"))

    # initialize HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)
    if win_label:
        win_label.visible = false

func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
    # Define actions and bind keys (arrows, space, R, Escape)
    var a_left = "ui_left"
    var a_right = "ui_right"
    var a_up = "ui_up"
    var a_attack = "ui_attack"
    var a_restart = "restart"
    var a_quit = "quit"

    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_LEFT)
    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_A)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_RIGHT)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_D)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_UP)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_W)
    _add_key_action(a_attack, KEY_SPACE)
    _add_key_action(a_restart, KEY_R)
    _add_key_action(a_quit, KEY_ESCAPE)

func _add_key_action(name: String, keycode: int) -> void:
    if not InputMap.has_action(name):
        InputMap.add_action(name)
    var ev := InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = keycode
    InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # handle restart and quit input here for prints/behavior
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        print("RESTART")
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

func _on_player_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
    hud_player_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)

func _on_rival_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
    hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)

func _on_player_died() -> void:
    # player died -> GAME OVER
    win_label.text = "GAME OVER"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("GAME OVER")
    get_tree().paused = true

func _on_rival_died() -> void:
    win_label.text = "WIN"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("WIN")
    get_tree().paused = true

func restart_game() -> void:
    # hide win text
    win_label.visible = false
    # reset fighters
    if player.has_method("reset"):
        player.reset(player_start_pos)
    if rival.has_method("reset"):
        rival.reset(rival_start_pos)
    # unpause
    get_tree().paused = false
    # refresh HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)

extends Node2D

# GameManager handles input setup, HUD updates, win/lose, restart and quit

@onready var player: Node = $Player
@onready var rival: Node = $Rival
var hud_player_bar_fg: ColorRect
var hud_rival_bar_fg: ColorRect
@onready var win_label: Label = $HUD/WinLabel

var player_start_pos: Vector2
var rival_start_pos: Vector2

var hud_player_bar_full_width: float = 300.0
var hud_rival_bar_full_width: float = 300.0

func _ready() -> void:
    # set window title via project settings (project.godot) should apply, but ensure in case
    if ProjectSettings.has_setting("application/config/name"):
        var name = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/name")
        if name:
            DisplayServer.window_set_title(str(name))

    _ensure_input_actions()

    # cache start positions
    player_start_pos = player.global_position
    rival_start_pos = rival.global_position

    # find HUD elements safely (use get_node_or_null to avoid tscn ordering issues)
    var hud := get_node_or_null("HUD")
    if hud:
        hud_player_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("PlayerBar/Foreground") else null
        hud_rival_bar_fg = hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar/Foreground") if hud.has_node("RivalBar/Foreground") else null
        # If missing, create simple ColorRect placeholders so updates won't error
        if not hud_player_bar_fg:
            var pb := hud.get_node_or_null("PlayerBar")
            if not pb:
                pb = ColorRect.new()
                pb.name = "PlayerBar"
                pb.rect_position = Vector2(50,10)
                hud.add_child(pb)
            hud_player_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_player_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_player_bar_fg.color = Color(1,0,0)
            pb.add_child(hud_player_bar_fg)
        if not hud_rival_bar_fg:
            var rb := hud.get_node_or_null("RivalBar")
            if not rb:
                rb = ColorRect.new()
                rb.name = "RivalBar"
                rb.rect_position = Vector2(450,10)
                hud.add_child(rb)
            hud_rival_bar_fg = ColorRect.new()
            hud_rival_bar_fg.name = "Foreground"
            hud_rival_bar_fg.color = Color(0,0,1)
            rb.add_child(hud_rival_bar_fg)

    # connect signals
    if player.has_signal("health_changed"):
        player.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_health_changed"))
    if player.has_signal("died"):
        player.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_died"))
    if rival.has_signal("health_changed"):
        rival.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_health_changed"))
    if rival.has_signal("died"):
        rival.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_died"))

    # initialize HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)
    if win_label:
        win_label.visible = false

func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
    # Define actions and bind keys (arrows, space, R, Escape)
    var a_left = "ui_left"
    var a_right = "ui_right"
    var a_up = "ui_up"
    var a_attack = "ui_attack"
    var a_restart = "restart"
    var a_quit = "quit"

    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_LEFT)
    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_A)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_RIGHT)
    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_D)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_UP)
    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_W)
    _add_key_action(a_attack, KEY_SPACE)
    _add_key_action(a_restart, KEY_R)
    _add_key_action(a_quit, KEY_ESCAPE)

func _add_key_action(name: String, keycode: int) -> void:
    if not InputMap.has_action(name):
        InputMap.add_action(name)
    var ev := InputEventKey.new()
    ev.physical_keycode = keycode
    InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    # handle restart and quit input here for prints/behavior
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        print("RESTART")
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

func _on_player_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
    if hud_player_bar_fg:
        var s: Vector2 = hud_player_bar_fg.rect_size
        s.x = hud_player_bar_full_width * clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
        hud_player_bar_fg.rect_size = s

func _on_rival_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
    var pct = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
    if hud_rival_bar_fg:
        var s: Vector2 = hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_size
        s.x = hud_rival_bar_full_width * clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
        hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_size = s

func _on_player_died() -> void:
    # player died -> GAME OVER
    win_label.text = "GAME OVER"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("GAME OVER")
    get_tree().paused = true

func _on_rival_died() -> void:
    win_label.text = "WIN"
    win_label.visible = true
    print("WIN")
    get_tree().paused = true

func restart_game() -> void:
    # hide win text
    win_label.visible = false
    # reset fighters
    if player.has_method("reset"):
        player.reset(player_start_pos)
    if rival.has_method("reset"):
        rival.reset(rival_start_pos)
    # unpause
    get_tree().paused = false
    # refresh HUD
    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)

+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if get_tree().paused:
+        return
+
+    # gravity
+    if not is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y += gravity * delta
+    else:
+        if velocity.y > 0:
+            velocity.y = 0
+
+    var dir = 0
+    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left"):
+        dir -= 1
+    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right"):

+            sprite.flip_h = false
+            print("MOVE RIGHT")
+    else:
+        velocity.x = lerp(velocity.x, 0, 0.2)
+
+    # jumping
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") and is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y = -jump_velocity
+        print("JUMP")
+
+    # punching
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_attack") and _can_punch and not _is_punching:
+        _do_punch()
+
+    # update punch timer
+    if not _can_punch:
+        _punch_timer -= delta
+        if _punch_timer <= 0:
+            _can_punch = true
+
+    # apply movement
+    velocity = move_and_slide(velocity, Vector2.UP)
+
+    # animations (if provided by designer)
+    if _is_punching:

+    elif abs(velocity.x) > 10:
+        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("walk"):
+            animation_player.play("walk")
+    else:
+        if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("idle"):
+            animation_player.play("idle")

+func _do_punch() -> void:
+    _can_punch = false
+    _is_punching = true
+    _punch_timer = punch_cooldown
+    print("PUNCH")
+
+    var duration = punch_duration_fallback
+    if animation_player and animation_player.has_animation("punch"):

+    _is_punching = false

+    _can_punch = true
+    _is_punching = false
+    if punch_area:

+extends Node2D
+
+# GameManager handles input setup, HUD updates, win/lose, restart and quit
+
+@onready var player: Node = $Player
+@onready var rival: Node = $Rival
+@onready var hud_player_bar_fg: ColorRect = $HUD/PlayerBar/Foreground
+@onready var hud_rival_bar_fg: ColorRect = $HUD/RivalBar/Foreground
+@onready var win_label: Label = $HUD/WinLabel
+
+var player_start_pos: Vector2
+var rival_start_pos: Vector2
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # set window title via project settings (project.godot) should apply, but ensure in case
+    if ProjectSettings.has_setting("application/config/name"):
+        var name = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/name")
+        if name:
+            OS.set_window_title(str(name))
+
+    _ensure_input_actions()
+
+    # cache start positions
+    player_start_pos = player.global_position
+    rival_start_pos = rival.global_position
+
+    # connect signals
+    if player.has_signal("health_changed"):
+        player.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_health_changed"))
+    if player.has_signal("died"):
+        player.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_player_died"))
+    if rival.has_signal("health_changed"):
+        rival.health_changed.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_health_changed"))
+    if rival.has_signal("died"):
+        rival.died.connect(Callable(self, "_on_rival_died"))
+
+    # initialize HUD
+    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
+    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)
+    win_label.visible = false
+
+func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
+    # Define actions and bind keys (arrows, space, R, Escape)
+    var a_left = "ui_left"
+    var a_right = "ui_right"
+    var a_up = "ui_up"
+    var a_attack = "ui_attack"
+    var a_restart = "restart"
+    var a_quit = "quit"
+
+    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_LEFT)
+    _add_key_action(a_left, KEY_A)
+    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_RIGHT)
+    _add_key_action(a_right, KEY_D)
+    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_UP)
+    _add_key_action(a_up, KEY_W)
+    _add_key_action(a_attack, KEY_SPACE)
+    _add_key_action(a_restart, KEY_R)
+    _add_key_action(a_quit, KEY_ESCAPE)
+
+func _add_key_action(name: String, keycode: int) -> void:
+    if not InputMap.has_action(name):
+        InputMap.add_action(name)
+    var ev := InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = keycode
+    InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # handle restart and quit input here for prints/behavior
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+        print("RESTART")
+        restart_game()
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+        print("QUIT")
+        get_tree().quit()
+
+func _on_player_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
+    var pct = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
+    hud_player_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+func _on_rival_health_changed(new_health: int) -> void:
+    var pct = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
+    hud_rival_bar_fg.rect_scale.x = clamp(pct, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+func _on_player_died() -> void:
+    # player died -> GAME OVER
+    win_label.text = "GAME OVER"
+    win_label.visible = true
+    print("GAME OVER")
+    get_tree().paused = true
+
+func _on_rival_died() -> void:
+    win_label.text = "WIN"
+    win_label.visible = true
+    print("WIN")
+    get_tree().paused = true
+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # hide win text
+    win_label.visible = false
+    # reset fighters
+    if player.has_method("reset"):
+        player.reset(player_start_pos)
+    if rival.has_method("reset"):
+        rival.reset(rival_start_pos)
+    # unpause
+    get_tree().paused = false
+    # refresh HUD
+    _on_player_health_changed(player.max_health)
+    _on_rival_health_changed(rival.max_health)

notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - 0 (game name/title) -> game/project.godot and game/main.tscn (window title).
  - 1 (player visible left) -> game/ui.gd (spawns Player), game/player.gd (renders sprite).
  - 2 (rival visible right) -> game/ui.gd, game/rival.gd.
  - 3 (wooden floor) -> game/main.tscn (ColorRect floor).
  - 4 (light background) -> game/project.godot (clear color) and main.tscn (background via root).
  - 5 (gravity for fighters) -> game/player.gd & game/rival.gd (CharacterBody2D with gravity).
  - 6/7/8 (LEFT/RIGHT/UP controls) -> game/player.gd (InputMap setup in UI but behavior in Player).
  - 9 (SPACE punch) -> game/player.gd + game/punch_hitbox.gd.
  - 10-16 (punch physics, slide, bounce, tween, flash, health loss, rival AI/punch cadence) -> player.gd, rival.gd, punch_hitbox.gd, ui.gd.
  - 17 (health bars) -> ui.gd + main.tscn HUD nodes.
  - 18-19 (win/lose freeze, restart) -> ui.gd with game_over flag, restart via R in ui.gd, fighter reset in player/rival.
  - 20 (Escape quit) -> ui.gd.
  - 21 (control print statements) -> player.gd and ui.gd printing events.
  - 22 (print WIN/GAME OVER) -> ui.gd.

- State ownership:
  - UI (game/ui.gd): owns overall game state: player_health, rival_health, game_over flag, HUD nodes, spawn/reset.
  - Player (game/player.gd) & Rival (game/rival.gd): own their local physics state (position, velocity, facing, health property mirror), and expose apply_damage(amount, knockback_vec) -> void. They call ui.on_health_changed(side, new_health).
  - PunchHitbox (game/punch_hitbox.gd): owner is the fighter that spawns it; it emits a hit to the overlapped body and calls the target's apply_damage.

- Cross-file interfaces (signatures):
  - Player.new(): Node creation. Player has:
    - func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void
    - var ui: Node (set by spawner)
    - var side: String ("player" or "rival")
  - Rival.new(): same interface as Player.
  - PunchHitbox.new(): Area2D that, when enabled, detects bodies and calls target.apply_damage(10, Vector2(knockback, -50))
  - UI methods:
    - func on_health_changed(side: String, new_health: int) -> void
    - func reset_round() -> void

- Coordinate convention:
  - World is 2D pixel coordinates, origin top-left. Floor y = 500; fighters positioned with centered sprites (Sprite2D default centered=true). Facing: left fighter faces right (facing = 1), right fighter faces left (facing = -1). Knockback applied to velocity.x, positive is to right.

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init: UI._ready() registers input actions, spawns Player & Rival at x=200 and x=600 on floor y.
  - run: physics enabled; player input moves/jumps/punches; rival AI moves/punches.
  - win/lose: when either health <= 0 UI sets game_over = true, shows message, prints to console, fighters stop acting.
  - reset: pressing R calls UI.reset_round(): resets health to 100, repositions fighters, clears velocities and game_over flag; prints RESTART.
  - quit: pressing Escape prints QUIT and calls get_tree().quit().

Now I will write the promised files (main.tscn, project.godot, and all .gd scripts). After writing, I'll run syntax and boot checks.

+++ game/punch_hitbox.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+extends Area2D
+
+# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
+# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.
+
+@export var damage: int = 10
+var attacker: Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
+    if not $CollisionShape2D:
+        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
+        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()

+

+extends Node2D
+

+@onready var rival_spawn: Node2D = $RivalSpawn
+@onready var player_health_rect: ColorRect = $HUD/PlayerHealth
+@onready var rival_health_rect: ColorRect = $HUD/RivalHealth
+@onready var message_label: Label = $HUD/MessageLabel
+
+var player: Node = null
+var rival: Node = null
+var game_over: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Input map
+    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_left"):
+        InputMap.add_action("ui_left")
+        var e = InputEventKey.new()
+        e.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
+        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_left", e)
+    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_right"):
+        InputMap.add_action("ui_right")
+        var e2 = InputEventKey.new()
+        e2.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
+        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_right", e2)
+    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_up"):
+        InputMap.add_action("ui_up")
+        var e3 = InputEventKey.new()
+        e3.physical_keycode = KEY_UP
+        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_up", e3)
+    if not InputMap.has_action("ui_accept"):
+        InputMap.add_action("ui_accept")
+        var e4 = InputEventKey.new()
+        e4.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
+        InputMap.action_add_event("ui_accept", e4)
+    # Restart and quit
+    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+        InputMap.add_action("restart")
+        var er = InputEventKey.new()
+        er.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+        InputMap.action_add_event("restart", er)
+    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+        InputMap.add_action("quit")
+        var eq = InputEventKey.new()
+        eq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+        InputMap.action_add_event("quit", eq)
+
+    spawn_fighters()
+    update_health_bars()
+
+func spawn_fighters() -> void:
+    # instantiate player and rival
+    var player_scene = load("res://player.gd")
+    player = player_scene.instantiate()
+    player.position = player_spawn.position
+    player.ui = self
+    add_child(player)
+
+    var rival_scene = load("res://rival.gd")
+    rival = rival_scene.instantiate()
+    rival.position = rival_spawn.position
+    rival.ui = self
+    rival.target = player
+    add_child(rival)
+
+func on_health_changed(side: String, new_health: int) -> void:
+    if side == "player":
+        var ratio = float(new_health) / float(player.max_health)
+        player_health_rect.rect_size.x = 300 * ratio
+    elif side == "rival":
+        var ratio = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
+        rival_health_rect.rect_size.x = 300 * ratio
+    # Check for win/lose
+    if not game_over:
+        if new_health <= 0:
+            game_over = true
+            if side == "rival":
+                message_label.text = "WIN"
+                print("WIN")
+            else:
+                message_label.text = "GAME OVER"
+                print("GAME OVER")
+            # Freeze fighters
+            player.set_physics_process(false)
+            rival.set_physics_process(false)
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart") and game_over:
+        print("RESTART")
+        reset_round()
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+        print("QUIT")
+        get_tree().quit()
+
+func reset_round() -> void:
+    # remove existing fighters
+    if player:
+        player.queue_free()
+    if rival:
+        rival.queue_free()
+    game_over = false
+    message_label.text = ""
+    spawn_fighters()
+    update_health_bars()
+
+func update_health_bars() -> void:
+    if player:
+        player_health_rect.rect_size.x = 300
+    if rival:
+        rival_health_rect.rect_size.x = 300

func spawn_fighters() -> void:

    player.ui = self

    if side == "player":

        player_health_rect.size = Vector2(300 * ratio, player_health_rect.size.y)
    elif side == "rival":
        var ratio = float(new_health) / float(rival.max_health)
        rival_health_rect.size = Vector2(300 * ratio, rival_health_rect.size.y)

    # remove existing fighters

    if rival:

extends CharacterBody2D
class_name Rival

@export var speed: float = 160.0
@export var jump_force: float = -380.0
@export var max_health: int = 100

var health: int = 100
var facing: int = -1 # faces left initially
var ui = null
var target: Node = null
var punch_cooldown: float = 1.0
var _punch_timer: float = 0.0

@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = Sprite2D.new()

func _ready() -> void:
    add_child(sprite)
    var tex = load("res://assets/blue_belt_fighter.png")
    if tex:
        sprite.texture = tex
        sprite.centered = true
        sprite.offset = Vector2.ZERO
    health = max_health
    set_physics_process(true)

func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
    health = max(0, health - amount)
    velocity.x = knockback.x
    velocity.y = knockback.y
    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1)
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1,1)
    if ui:
        ui.on_health_changed("rival", health)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    if ui and ui.game_over:
        return
    if not target:
        return
    var dir = sign(target.position.x - position.x)
    facing = dir
    # move toward player if far
    var dist = abs(target.position.x - position.x)
    if dist > 120:
        velocity.x = dir * speed
    else:
        velocity.x = 0
        # punch if close and cooldown elapsed
        _punch_timer -= delta
        if _punch_timer <= 0:
            _do_punch()
            _punch_timer = punch_cooldown
    # gravity
    if not is_on_floor():
        velocity.y += 20
    move_and_slide()

func _do_punch() -> void:
    print("RIVAL PUNCH")
    # lunge
    var orig_x = position.x
    var lunge = -16 * facing
    position.x += lunge
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
    position.x = orig_x
    var hb = preload("res://punch_hitbox.gd").new()
    hb.attacker = self
    hb.damage = 10
    hb.position = position + Vector2(30 * facing, -10)
    get_parent().add_child(hb)

func reset(to_pos: Vector2) -> void:
    position = to_pos
    health = max_health
    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
    if ui:
        ui.on_health_changed("rival", health)

extends Area2D

# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.

@export var damage: int = 10
var attacker: Node = null

func _ready() -> void:
    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
    if not has_node("CollisionShape2D"):
        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
        shape.size = Vector2(40, 30)
        cs.shape = shape
        add_child(cs)
    connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
    # Auto-free shortly to make it a transient hitbox
    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
    if is_instance_valid(self):
        queue_free()

func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
    if not is_instance_valid(attacker):
        return
    # Don't hit the attacker
    if body == attacker:
        return
    if body.has_method("apply_damage"):
        # Compute knockback away from the attacker so the target is pushed correctly
        var dir = 1
        if is_instance_valid(attacker) and attacker.has_method("get_global_position"):
            # Use positions to determine direction: positive to the right
            dir = sign(body.global_position.x - attacker.global_position.x)
            if dir == 0:
                dir = 1
        else:
            # Fallback: assume attacker faces right
            dir = 1
        var knockback = Vector2(200 * dir, -120)
        body.apply_damage(damage, knockback)
        # Only hit once
        queue_free()

--- game/punch_hitbox.gd
+++ game/punch_hitbox.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+extends Area2D
+
+# The punch hitbox detects overlaps during a short window and calls apply_damage on targets.
+# Expected to be instantiated by a fighter and have 'attacker' and 'damage' properties set.
+
+@export var damage: int = 10
+var attacker: Node = null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Create a CollisionShape2D if none exists
+    if not $CollisionShape2D:
+        var cs = CollisionShape2D.new()
+        var shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
+        shape.size = Vector2(40, 30)
+        cs.shape = shape
+        add_child(cs)
+    connect("body_entered", Callable(self, "_on_body_entered"))
+    # Auto-free shortly to make it a transient hitbox
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    if is_instance_valid(self):
+        queue_free()
+
+func _on_body_entered(body: Node) -> void:
+    if not is_instance_valid(attacker):
+        return
+    # Don't hit the attacker
+    if body == attacker:
+        return
+    if body.has_method("apply_damage"):
+        var knockback = Vector2(200 * (attacker.facing if attacker.has_method("facing") or hasattr(attacker, "facing") else (1)), -120)
+        # Fallback: if attacker has 'facing' property use it, otherwise use sign of x-direction
+        if hasattr(attacker, "facing"):
+            knockback = Vector2(200 * attacker.facing, -120)
+        body.apply_damage(damage, knockback)
+        # Only hit once
+        queue_free()

+extends CharacterBody2D
+class_name Player
+
+@export var speed: float = 220.0
+@export var jump_force: float = -420.0
+@export var max_health: int = 100
+
+var health: int = 100
+var facing: int = 1 # 1 = right, -1 = left
+var ui = null
+var game_over: bool = false
+
+@onready var sprite: Sprite2D = Sprite2D.new()
+
+func _init() -> void:
+    # create sprite
+    pass
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Setup sprite
+    add_child(sprite)
+    var tex = load("res://assets/red_belt_fighter.png")
+    if tex:
+        sprite.texture = tex
+        sprite.centered = true
+        sprite.offset = Vector2.ZERO
+    position = Vector2(200, 420)
+    health = max_health
+    set_physics_process(true)
+
+func apply_damage(amount: int, knockback: Vector2) -> void:
+    health = max(0, health - amount)
+    # Apply knockback velocity
+    velocity.x = knockback.x
+    velocity.y = knockback.y
+    # Flash white
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1)
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
+    sprite.modulate = Color(1,1,1,1)
+    if ui:
+        ui.on_health_changed("player", health)
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if ui and ui.game_over:
+        return
+    var input_left = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left")
+    var input_right = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right")
+    var move_dir = 0
+    if input_left:
+        move_dir -= 1
+    if input_right:
+        move_dir += 1
+    if move_dir < 0:
+        facing = -1
+    elif move_dir > 0:
+        facing = 1
+    if move_dir != 0:
+        velocity.x = move_dir * speed
+        if move_dir < 0:
+            print("MOVE LEFT")
+        else:
+            print("MOVE RIGHT")
+    else:
+        velocity.x = 0
+    # gravity
+    if not is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y += 20
+    # jump
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_up") and is_on_floor():
+        velocity.y = jump_force
+        print("JUMP")
+    # punch
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept"):
+        _do_punch()
+    move_and_slide()
+
+func _do_punch() -> void:
+    print("PUNCH")
+    # tween lunge forward and back - simple velocity impulse
+    var orig_x = position.x
+    var lunge = 20 * facing
+    position.x += lunge
+    await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
+    position.x = orig_x
+    # spawn hitbox
+    var hb = load("res://punch_hitbox.gd").instantiate()
+    hb.attacker = self
+    hb.damage = 10
+    hb.position = position + Vector2(30 * facing, -10)
+    get_parent().add_child(hb)
+
+func reset(to_pos: Vector2) -> void:
+    position = to_pos
+    health = max_health
+    velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+    if ui:
+        ui.on_health_changed("player", health)

notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Window title, main loop, input, health bars, floor, game state, restart/quit: game/main.py
  - Fighter behavior (movement, gravity, jump, punch, health, flash, knockback): game/fighter.py
  - Constants (sizes, colors, physics, timings): game/constants.py
  - Package init: game/__init__.py

- State ownership:

+import pygame
+from pathlib import Path
+from game import constants as C
+
+class Fighter:
+    """
+    Fighter represents a player or AI-controlled fighter.
+
+    Methods:
+    - update(dt: float, floor_y: int, target: 'Fighter'|None=None)
+    - draw(surface: pygame.Surface)
+    - punch() -> bool
+    - check_punch_hit(other: 'Fighter') -> bool
+    - take_damage(amount: int)
+    - apply_knockback(amount: float)
+
+    Attributes are kept public for simplicity (position via rect, health etc.).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, x: float, image_path: str, facing: str = 'right', is_ai: bool = False):
+        self.is_ai = is_ai
+        self.facing = facing  # 'left' or 'right'
+        self.image = pygame.image.load(image_path).convert_alpha()
+        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()
+        # anchor by midbottom to the given x; caller should set rect.midbottom after init
+        self.rect.centerx = int(x)
+        self.vx = 0.0
+        self.vy = 0.0
+
+        self.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+
+        # Punch state
+        self.is_punching = False
+        self.punch_timer = 0.0
+        # cooldown timer until can punch again
+        self.cooldown_timer = 0.0
+        self.punch_range = C.PUNCH_RANGE
+        self.punch_damage = C.PUNCH_DAMAGE
+        self.punch_hit_registered = False
+
+        # Flash when hit
+        self.flash_timer = 0.0
+
+    def rect_midbottom(self):
+        return self.rect.midbottom
+
+    def update(self, dt: float, floor_y: int, target: 'Fighter' = None):
+        """Update physics and AI. If target is provided and is_ai True, the fighter will move/punch toward target."""
+        # Apply gravity
+        self.vy += C.GRAVITY * dt
+        # Integrate position
+        self.rect.x += int(self.vx * dt)
+        self.rect.y += int(self.vy * dt)
+
+        # Floor collision
+        if self.rect.bottom >= floor_y:
+            self.rect.bottom = floor_y
+            # If falling, stop vertical velocity
+            if self.vy > 0:
+                self.vy = 0
+
+        # Timers
+        if self.is_punching:
+            self.punch_timer -= dt
+            if self.punch_timer <= 0:
+                self.is_punching = False
+                self.punch_timer = 0
+                # reset hit registration so future punches can hit
+                self.punch_hit_registered = False
+        if self.cooldown_timer > 0:
+            self.cooldown_timer -= dt
+            if self.cooldown_timer < 0:
+                self.cooldown_timer = 0
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            self.flash_timer -= dt
+            if self.flash_timer < 0:
+                self.flash_timer = 0
+
+        # AI behavior
+        if self.is_ai and target is not None:
+            self._ai_behavior(dt, target)
+
+    def _ai_behavior(self, dt: float, target: 'Fighter'):
+        # Walk toward the player
+        if target.rect.centerx < self.rect.centerx - 5:
+            # player is left
+            self.vx = -C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif target.rect.centerx > self.rect.centerx + 5:
+            self.vx = C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+        else:
+            self.vx = 0
+
+        # If close, attempt to punch
+        distance = abs(target.rect.centerx - self.rect.centerx)
+        if distance <= C.AI_PUNCH_DISTANCE and self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            # Start punch
+            self.punch()
+            # AI uses its cooldown
+            self.cooldown_timer = C.AI_PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+
+    def start_move(self, direction: str):
+        if direction == 'left':
+            self.vx = -C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif direction == 'right':
+            self.vx = C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+
+    def stop_move(self):
+        self.vx = 0
+
+    def jump(self):
+        # Only allow jump if on floor
+        if self.vy == 0:
+            self.vy = -C.JUMP_SPEED
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def punch(self) -> bool:
+        # Start punch if not in cooldown
+        if self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            self.is_punching = True
+            self.punch_timer = C.PUNCH_DURATION
+            # set cooldown (player and AI may have different cooldown handled by caller)
+            # register hit false until we actually hit
+            self.punch_hit_registered = False
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def check_punch_hit(self, other: 'Fighter') -> bool:
+        """Check whether this fighter's current punch hits the other. If it does, apply damage and knockback and return True."""
+        if not self.is_punching:
+            return False
+        if self.punch_hit_registered:
+            return False
+
+        # Build punch rect in front of fighter
+        if self.facing == 'right':
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.right, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+        else:
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.left - self.punch_range, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+
+        if punch_rect.colliderect(other.rect):
+            # Register hit so one punch only hits once
+            self.punch_hit_registered = True
+            other.take_damage(self.punch_damage)
+            # Knockback: per Plan, opponent x-position decreases if attacker facing right, increases if facing left
+            if self.facing == 'right':
+                other.apply_knockback(-C.KNOCKBACK)
+            else:
+                other.apply_knockback(C.KNOCKBACK)
+            # Flash other
+            other.flash_timer = C.FLASH_TIME
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def take_damage(self, amount: int):
+        self.health -= int(amount)
+        if self.health < 0:
+            self.health = 0
+
+    def apply_knockback(self, amount: float):
+        # Move the rect horizontally by amount pixels
+        self.rect.x += int(amount)
+
+    def draw(self, surface: pygame.Surface):
+        surface.blit(self.image, self.rect)
+        # Draw flash overlay if needed
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            overlay = pygame.Surface((self.rect.width, self.rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
+            overlay.fill((255, 255, 255, 160))
+            surface.blit(overlay, self.rect)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.health > 0

+
+
+def load_asset(name: str) -> str:
+    path = ASSET_DIR / name
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing asset: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+class Game:
+    def __init__(self):
+        pygame.init()
+        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.SCREEN_HEIGHT))
+        pygame.display.set_caption('Dojo Duel')
+        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
+        self.font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
+        self.big_font = pygame.font.Font(None, 72)
+
+        self.running = True
+        self.state = 'playing'  # 'playing' or 'ended'
+
+        # Input flags
+        self.moving_left = False
+        self.moving_right = False
+
+        self._load_assets()
+        self.init_game()
+
+    def _load_assets(self):
+        # Load fighter images paths
+        self.red_path = load_asset('red_belt_fighter.png')
+        self.blue_path = load_asset('blue_belt_fighter.png')
+
+    def init_game(self):
+        # Create fighters
+        # Player on left
+        player_x = 150
+        rival_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - 150
+        self.player = Fighter(player_x, self.red_path, facing='right', is_ai=False)
+        self.rival = Fighter(rival_x, self.blue_path, facing='left', is_ai=True)
+        # Anchor to floor
+        self.player.rect.midbottom = (player_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        self.rival.rect.midbottom = (rival_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+
+        # Reset additional state
+        self.player.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.rival.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.player.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.rival.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.player.is_punching = False
+        self.rival.is_punching = False
+        self.player.punch_timer = 0
+        self.rival.punch_timer = 0
+        self.player.flash_timer = 0
+        self.rival.flash_timer = 0
+
+        self.state = 'playing'
+        self.last_end_printed = False
+
+    def run(self):
+        while self.running:
+            dt = self.clock.tick(C.FPS) / 1000.0
+            self._handle_events()
+            if self.state == 'playing':
+                self._update(dt)
+                self._check_hits()
+                self._check_end()
+            self._draw()
+            pygame.display.flip()
+        pygame.quit()
+
+    def _handle_events(self):
+        for event in pygame.event.get():
+            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
+                print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                self.running = False
+                return
+            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
+                    print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                    self.running = False
+                    return
+                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
+                    # Restart
+                    print('RESTART', flush=True)
+                    self.init_game()
+                if self.state != 'playing':
+                    # When ended, only allow restart/quit
+                    continue
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = True
+                    self.player.start_move('left')
+                    print('MOVE LEFT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = True
+                    self.player.start_move('right')
+                    print('MOVE RIGHT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:
+                    if self.player.jump():
+                        print('JUMP', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
+                    started = self.player.punch()
+                    if started:
+                        # apply player cooldown
+                        self.player.cooldown_timer = C.PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+                        print('PUNCH', flush=True)
+            elif event.type == pygame.KEYUP:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = False
+                    # if right still held, move right
+                    if self.moving_right:
+                        self.player.start_move('right')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = False
+                    if self.moving_left:
+                        self.player.start_move('left')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+
+    def _update(self, dt: float):
+        # Update fighters
+        # Player update
+        self.player.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        # Rival update with AI
+        self.rival.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y, target=self.player)
+
+    def _check_hits(self):
+        # Player punch hits rival
+        if self.player.check_punch_hit(self.rival):
+            # Print damage event? Not required; health bar updates visually
+            pass
+        # Rival punch hits player
+        if self.rival.check_punch_hit(self.player):
+            pass
+
+    def _check_end(self):
+        if not self.rival.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('WIN', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+        elif not self.player.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('GAME OVER', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+
+    def _draw(self):
+        # Background
+        self.screen.fill(C.LIGHT_BG)
+        # Floor
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.WOOD_BROWN, (0, C.FLOOR_Y, C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.FLOOR_HEIGHT))
+
+        # Fighters
+        self.player.draw(self.screen)
+        self.rival.draw(self.screen)
+
+        # Health bars
+        # Player bar (left)
+        pb_x = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (pb_x, pb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_w = int((self.player.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_PLAYER, (pb_x, pb_y, player_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_text = self.font.render('Player', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(player_text, (pb_x, pb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # Rival bar (right)
+        rb_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN - C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH
+        rb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (rb_x, rb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_w = int((self.rival.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_RIVAL, (rb_x + (C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_w), rb_y, rival_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_text = self.font.render('Rival', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(rival_text, (rb_x + C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_text.get_width(), rb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # If ended, display message and freeze
+        if self.state == 'ended':
+            if not self.player.is_alive():
+                msg = 'GAME OVER'
+            else:
+                msg = 'WIN'
+            text_surf = self.big_font.render(msg, True, C.BLACK)
+            self.screen.blit(text_surf, ((C.SCREEN_WIDTH - text_surf.get_width()) // 2, (C.SCREEN_HEIGHT - text_surf.get_height()) // 2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    game = Game()
+    game.run()

+        """Update physics and AI. If target is provided and is_ai True, the fighter will move/punch toward target."""
+        # Apply gravity
+        self.vy += C.GRAVITY * dt
+        # Integrate position
+        self.rect.x += int(self.vx * dt)
+        self.rect.y += int(self.vy * dt)
+
+        # Floor collision
+        if self.rect.bottom >= floor_y:
+            self.rect.bottom = floor_y
+            # If falling, stop vertical velocity
+            if self.vy > 0:
+                self.vy = 0
+
+        # Timers
+        if self.is_punching:
+            self.punch_timer -= dt
+            if self.punch_timer <= 0:
+                self.is_punching = False
+                self.punch_timer = 0
+                # reset hit registration so future punches can hit
+                self.punch_hit_registered = False
+        if self.cooldown_timer > 0:
+            self.cooldown_timer -= dt
+            if self.cooldown_timer < 0:
+                self.cooldown_timer = 0
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            self.flash_timer -= dt
+            if self.flash_timer < 0:
+                self.flash_timer = 0
+
+        # AI behavior
+        if self.is_ai and target is not None:
+            self._ai_behavior(dt, target)
+
+    def _ai_behavior(self, dt: float, target: 'Fighter'):
+        # Walk toward the player
+        if target.rect.centerx < self.rect.centerx - 5:
+            # player is left
+            self.vx = -C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif target.rect.centerx > self.rect.centerx + 5:
+            self.vx = C.AI_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+        else:
+            self.vx = 0
+
+        # If close, attempt to punch
+        distance = abs(target.rect.centerx - self.rect.centerx)
+        if distance <= C.AI_PUNCH_DISTANCE and self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            # Start punch
+            self.punch()
+            # AI uses its cooldown
+            self.cooldown_timer = C.AI_PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+
+    def start_move(self, direction: str):
+        if direction == 'left':
+            self.vx = -C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'left'
+        elif direction == 'right':
+            self.vx = C.MOVE_SPEED
+            self.facing = 'right'
+
+    def stop_move(self):
+        self.vx = 0
+
+    def jump(self):
+        # Only allow jump if on floor
+        if self.vy == 0:
+            self.vy = -C.JUMP_SPEED
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def punch(self) -> bool:
+        # Start punch if not in cooldown
+        if self.cooldown_timer <= 0 and not self.is_punching:
+            self.is_punching = True
+            self.punch_timer = C.PUNCH_DURATION
+            # set cooldown (player and AI may have different cooldown handled by caller)
+            # register hit false until we actually hit
+            self.punch_hit_registered = False
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def check_punch_hit(self, other: 'Fighter') -> bool:
+        """Check whether this fighter's current punch hits the other. If it does, apply damage and knockback and return True."""
+        if not self.is_punching:
+            return False
+        if self.punch_hit_registered:
+            return False
+
+        # Build punch rect in front of fighter
+        if self.facing == 'right':
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.right, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+        else:
+            punch_rect = pygame.Rect(self.rect.left - self.punch_range, self.rect.top + 10, self.punch_range, self.rect.height - 20)
+
+        if punch_rect.colliderect(other.rect):
+            # Register hit so one punch only hits once
+            self.punch_hit_registered = True
+            other.take_damage(self.punch_damage)
+            # Knockback: per Plan, opponent x-position decreases if attacker facing right, increases if facing left
+            if self.facing == 'right':
+                other.apply_knockback(-C.KNOCKBACK)
+            else:
+                other.apply_knockback(C.KNOCKBACK)
+            # Flash other
+            other.flash_timer = C.FLASH_TIME
+            return True
+        return False
+
+    def take_damage(self, amount: int):
+        self.health -= int(amount)
+        if self.health < 0:
+            self.health = 0
+
+    def apply_knockback(self, amount: float):
+        # Move the rect horizontally by amount pixels
+        self.rect.x += int(amount)
+
+    def draw(self, surface: pygame.Surface):
+        surface.blit(self.image, self.rect)
+        # Draw flash overlay if needed
+        if self.flash_timer > 0:
+            overlay = pygame.Surface((self.rect.width, self.rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
+            overlay.fill((255, 255, 255, 160))
+            surface.blit(overlay, self.rect)
+
+    def is_alive(self):
+        return self.health > 0

+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+import pygame
+from pathlib import Path
+from game import constants as C
+from game.fighter import Fighter
+
+ASSET_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'assets'
+
+
+def load_asset(name: str) -> str:
+    path = ASSET_DIR / name
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing asset: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+class Game:
+    def __init__(self):
+        pygame.init()
+        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.SCREEN_HEIGHT))
+        pygame.display.set_caption('Dojo Duel')
+        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
+        self.font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)
+        self.big_font = pygame.font.Font(None, 72)
+
+        self.running = True
+        self.state = 'playing'  # 'playing' or 'ended'
+
+        # Input flags
+        self.moving_left = False
+        self.moving_right = False
+
+        self._load_assets()
+        self.init_game()
+
+    def _load_assets(self):
+        # Load fighter images paths
+        self.red_path = load_asset('red_belt_fighter.png')
+        self.blue_path = load_asset('blue_belt_fighter.png')
+
+    def init_game(self):
+        # Create fighters
+        # Player on left
+        player_x = 150
+        rival_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - 150
+        self.player = Fighter(player_x, self.red_path, facing='right', is_ai=False)
+        self.rival = Fighter(rival_x, self.blue_path, facing='left', is_ai=True)
+        # Anchor to floor
+        self.player.rect.midbottom = (player_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        self.rival.rect.midbottom = (rival_x, C.FLOOR_Y)
+
+        # Reset additional state
+        self.player.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.rival.health = C.MAX_HEALTH
+        self.player.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.rival.cooldown_timer = 0
+        self.player.is_punching = False
+        self.rival.is_punching = False
+        self.player.punch_timer = 0
+        self.rival.punch_timer = 0
+        self.player.flash_timer = 0
+        self.rival.flash_timer = 0
+
+        self.state = 'playing'
+        self.last_end_printed = False
+
+    def run(self):
+        while self.running:
+            dt = self.clock.tick(C.FPS) / 1000.0
+            self._handle_events()
+            if self.state == 'playing':
+                self._update(dt)
+                self._check_hits()
+                self._check_end()
+            self._draw()
+            pygame.display.flip()
+        pygame.quit()
+
+    def _handle_events(self):
+        for event in pygame.event.get():
+            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
+                print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                self.running = False
+                return
+            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
+                    print('QUIT', flush=True)
+                    self.running = False
+                    return
+                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
+                    # Restart
+                    print('RESTART', flush=True)
+                    self.init_game()
+                if self.state != 'playing':
+                    # When ended, only allow restart/quit
+                    continue
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = True
+                    self.player.start_move('left')
+                    print('MOVE LEFT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = True
+                    self.player.start_move('right')
+                    print('MOVE RIGHT', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:
+                    if self.player.jump():
+                        print('JUMP', flush=True)
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
+                    started = self.player.punch()
+                    if started:
+                        # apply player cooldown
+                        self.player.cooldown_timer = C.PUNCH_COOLDOWN
+                        print('PUNCH', flush=True)
+            elif event.type == pygame.KEYUP:
+                if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
+                    self.moving_left = False
+                    # if right still held, move right
+                    if self.moving_right:
+                        self.player.start_move('right')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+                elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
+                    self.moving_right = False
+                    if self.moving_left:
+                        self.player.start_move('left')
+                    else:
+                        self.player.stop_move()
+
+    def _update(self, dt: float):
+        # Update fighters
+        # Player update
+        self.player.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y)
+        # Rival update with AI
+        self.rival.update(dt, C.FLOOR_Y, target=self.player)
+
+    def _check_hits(self):
+        # Player punch hits rival
+        if self.player.check_punch_hit(self.rival):
+            # Print damage event? Not required; health bar updates visually
+            pass
+        # Rival punch hits player
+        if self.rival.check_punch_hit(self.player):
+            pass
+
+    def _check_end(self):
+        if not self.rival.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('WIN', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+        elif not self.player.is_alive():
+            self.state = 'ended'
+            if not self.last_end_printed:
+                print('GAME OVER', flush=True)
+                self.last_end_printed = True
+
+    def _draw(self):
+        # Background
+        self.screen.fill(C.LIGHT_BG)
+        # Floor
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.WOOD_BROWN, (0, C.FLOOR_Y, C.SCREEN_WIDTH, C.FLOOR_HEIGHT))
+
+        # Fighters
+        self.player.draw(self.screen)
+        self.rival.draw(self.screen)
+
+        # Health bars
+        # Player bar (left)
+        pb_x = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (pb_x, pb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_w = int((self.player.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_PLAYER, (pb_x, pb_y, player_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        player_text = self.font.render('Player', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(player_text, (pb_x, pb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # Rival bar (right)
+        rb_x = C.SCREEN_WIDTH - C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN - C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH
+        rb_y = C.HEALTH_BAR_MARGIN
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_BG, (rb_x, rb_y, C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_w = int((self.rival.health / C.MAX_HEALTH) * C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH)
+        pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, C.HEALTH_RIVAL, (rb_x + (C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_w), rb_y, rival_w, C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT))
+        rival_text = self.font.render('Rival', True, C.BLACK)
+        self.screen.blit(rival_text, (rb_x + C.HEALTH_BAR_WIDTH - rival_text.get_width(), rb_y + C.HEALTH_BAR_HEIGHT + 4))
+
+        # If ended, display message and freeze
+        if self.state == 'ended':
+            if not self.player.is_alive():
+                msg = 'GAME OVER'
+            else:
+                msg = 'WIN'
+            text_surf = self.big_font.render(msg, True, C.BLACK)
+            self.screen.blit(text_surf, ((C.SCREEN_WIDTH - text_surf.get_width()) // 2, (C.SCREEN_HEIGHT - text_surf.get_height()) // 2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    game = Game()
+    game.run()
